Local: Presencial - Região da Paulista

Regime: CLT

Horário: Comercial - 5x2


Sobre a vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Atendente de E‑commerce (Nível 1) para atuar diretamente no atendimento aos clientes em marketplaces como Shopee, Mercado Livre, TikTok Shop e outros canais digitais .


Este profissional será responsável por garantir uma experiência positiva ao cliente, oferecendo suporte eficiente, cordial e alinhado às políticas da empresa.


Responsabilidades

  • Atender clientes via chat, e-mail e mensagens nos principais marketplaces.
  • Responder dúvidas gerais: produtos, prazos, formas de envio, políticas e status do pedido.
  • Auxiliar clientes na criação, acompanhamento, cancelamento e atualização de pedidos.
  • Tratar solicitações de troca, devolução e reembolso.
  • Registrar interações no sistema seguindo scripts e procedimentos internos.
  • Monitorar e responder avaliações e mensagens em todas as plataformas.
  • Identificar e relatar problemas recorrentes, como divergências de pedido, atrasos logísticos ou itens danificados, escalando corretamente para o time L2/Operações.
  • Apresentar promoções, campanhas e oportunidades ao cliente.
  • Encaminhar solicitações que exigem análise profunda para as equipes responsáveis.


Requisitos

  • Ensino médio completo.
  • Experiência prévia com e-commerce ou atendimento ao cliente é desejável.
  • Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal em Português.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente dinâmico e com múltiplos atendimentos simultâneos.
  • Organização, foco e agilidade.
  • Inglês é um diferencial.


Diferenciais desejáveis

  • Experiência com Shopee, Mercado Livre ou TikTok Shop.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM, OMS ou ERPs.
  • Conhecimento básico de logística e políticas de marketplaces.


Benefícios

  • Vale‑refeição
  • Vale‑transporte
  • Plano de saúde (conforme política interna).
  • Plano odontológico (opcional).


Por que trabalhar conosco?

Somos uma empresa em crescimento, com forte presença em marketplaces e foco na qualidade da experiência do cliente.


Valorizamos pessoas comprometidas, comunicativas e com vontade de evoluir profissionalmente no universo do e-commerce.

title: Gerente Soluções SAP
description:
A Atos é uma líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 94.000 colaboradores e uma receita anual de aproximadamente €11 bilhões de euros. Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europaea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.


Gerente Soluções – SAP


Local: Híbrido 2 vezes por semana em São Paulo (Capital).

Horário: 09:00 – 18:00.


Buscamos Gerente Soluções SAP Sênior, para integrar nosso time de pré-vendas. O profissional atuará em apoio direto à área comercial, definindo estratégias técnicas, coordenando entregas e garantindo propostas competitivas e aderentes às necessidades dos clientes.


Responsabilidades:

  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com a equipe de vendas para identificar oportunidades e desenvolver estratégias SAP para os clientes;
  • Realizar apresentações técnicas e demonstrações de produtos para clientes potenciais, destacando benefícios e funcionalidades das soluções SAP;
  • Avaliar e compreender os requisitos SAP dos clientes e oferecer recomendações de soluções adequadas;
  • Colaborar com as equipes de engenharia e desenvolvimento para garantir que as soluções oferecidas atendam às necessidades dos clientes;
  • Elaborar custeio e precificação de soluções SAP, garantindo competitividade e adequação ao mercado;
  • Compreender e gerenciar o ciclo de venda, desde a identificação de oportunidades até o fechamento de contratos;
  • Desenvolver propostas técnicas e comerciais para empresas públicas e privadas, garantindo o cumprimento dos requisitos regulatórios e das especificações do cliente;
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento de propostas técnicas e documentos de resposta a RFPs/RFIs;
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tendências e tecnologias em SAP e disseminar conhecimento na equipe.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada em SAP, preferencialmente com atuação em pré-venda;
  • Experiência em elaboração de propostas para empresas públicas e privadas;
  • Atuação comprovada como mandatário de delivery (responsável pela coordenação/entrega de projetos) ou Consultor SAP nas áreas logística (MM/SD/WM/Transportation) ou financeira (FI/CO), com forte conhecimento dos processos de negócio;
  • Conhecimentos sólidos de integração de sistemas, gestão de dados e conformidade regulatória em ambientes SAP;
  • Experiência com provedores de nuvem/hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) em ambientes de nuvem pública;
  • Vivência com parceiros tecnológicos e integradores no mercado brasileiro;
  • Formação superior em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia da Computação, Administração, Contabilidade, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas será diferencial;
  • Inglês avançado (leitura, escrita e conversação) — uso cotidiano;
  • Certificações relevantes em SAP serão consideradas diferencial;
  • Capacidade para trabalhar de forma autônoma e colaborativa;
  • Habilidade para comunicar conceitos técnicos de forma clara a públicos técnicos e executivos;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens conforme necessário.


Benefícios:

  • Vale refeição ou Vale alimentação;
  • Plano de saúde extensível a cônjuge e filhos;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Programa de remuneração variável;
  • Auxílio creche - conforme regras sindicais da localidade;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Convênio com farmácias – descontos em medicamentos;
  • Previdência Privada com seguro de vida adicional
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Empréstimo Consignado (após 1 ano de empresa);
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras (Descontos para realização de graduação, pós-graduação, MBA e Idiomas);
  • Política de Subsídios para Pós-graduação, MBAs e Certificações (A Atos apoia o seu desenvolvimento, subsidiando financeiramente ações externas);
  • Speexx (curso online de até 5 idiomas gratuitamente)
  • Programa de treinamentos internos e externos;
  • Universidade corporativa (E-learning com milhares de cursos disponíveis gratuitamente);
  • Espaço Saúde (suporte com atendimento médico - presencial ou online - para os funcionários e seus familiares e contamos também com os programas de bem-estar e qualidade de vida);
  • Terapia online;
  • Programa de acompanhamento à gestante (acompanhamento médico online durante a gestação para colaboradoras ou cônjuges);
  • Programa Minha Nova Parceria de Confiança (para colaboradores e cônjuges. Válido também para filhos adotivos) - Brinde especial + Cartão presente com valor em dinheiro;
  • Day off no seu aniversário;
  • Parceria com a Samsung (descontos na compra de diversos produtos);
  • Bônus de indicação para nossas vagas (conforme política interna);
  • Jubileu (premiação personalizada por tempo de empresa);
  • Accolade (Programa de reconhecimento).


Aviso de Diversidade

Entendemos a diversidade como um fator valioso. Todas as nossas oportunidades são Afirmativas para Pessoas com Deficiência.

Valorizamos a diversidade independentemente de identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, etnia, idade, deficiência, nacionalidade ou qualquer outro aspecto.


Aviso de Proteção de Dados

Os dados pessoais coletados serão utilizados exclusivamente para o processo seletivo e tratados conforme os níveis de segurança adotados pela Atos.

Caso haja alguma dúvida relacionada à proteção de dados ou qualquer aspecto envolvendo o tratamento realizado, você pode entrar em contato por meio do canal: .

title: Data Annotator
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.


Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


We’re excited to share that Innodata Inc. is expanding its AI and Machine Learning Talent Network , and we’re looking for passionate, detail-oriented professionals to join us as Data Annotators and Content Moderators (Review & Labeling) .

If you enjoy working with data, have a strong eye for detail, and wish to contribute to real-world AI innovation , this is a wonderful opportunity to become part of a forward-thinking global team .

Location: Brazil.


Key Responsibilities

  • Review, label, and moderate online content (may include sensitive material).
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and overall quality.
  • Contribute to building AI training datasets for next-generation systems.
  • Provide feedback and insights to enhance ongoing processes.


Requirements

  • Minimum qualification: Bachelors (or higher) .
  • Strong command of English (written and verbal) .
  • Excellent analytical and communication skills .
  • Comfortable working with diverse content types.
  • Access to a private, secure workspace with stable internet .


If you’re detail-oriented, tech-curious , and eager to contribute to the future of AI , we’d love to have you in our growing network.

title: Tech Lead Hands-on (Microsoft Stack)
description:
Tech Lead Hands-on (Microsoft Stack)


Sobre a vaga:


Estamos em busca de um(a) Tech Lead Hands-on com sólida bagagem técnica e experiência no ecossistema Microsoft, para liderar o desenvolvimento de soluções de IA, automação e produtividade em um ambiente colaborativo e inovador.


Essa posição combina liderança técnica e atuação prática em código , com foco em prototipar MVPs , garantir boas práticas de engenharia e impulsionar o uso de tecnologias Microsoft como Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, SharePoint e Databricks .


A atuação é 100% remota , mas seria um diferencial profissionais com disponibilidade para encontros presenciais em Guarulhos – SP, uma vez por semana .

Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar tecnicamente times multidisciplinares no desenho e execução de soluções em nuvem e IA.
  • Atuar de forma hands-on , participando ativamente de análises, codificação e revisão de código.
  • Prototipar e desenvolver MVPs (Minimum Viable Products) para validação e aceleração de entregas.
  • Utilizar a Microsoft Suite completa (Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Power Apps, Power Automate, SharePoint) na criação de soluções integradas.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de dados e negócio para identificar oportunidades de automação e eficiência.
  • Garantir qualidade técnica, segurança, performance e escalabilidade das soluções construídas.

Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência comprovada como Tech Lead , Engenheiro(a) de Software ou Arquiteto(a) de Soluções , com atuação prática em desenvolvimento.
  • Conhecimento avançado em Azure Cloud (preferencialmente AI e Data Services).
  • Experiência com Azure AI Foundry e Copilot Studio .
  • Domínio em Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, SharePoint).
  • Vivência com Databricks e integração de dados e APIs.
  • Capacidade de construir e evoluir provas de conceito e MVPs funcionais .
  • Forte base em engenharia de software (versionamento, testes, pipelines de CI/CD, boas práticas).

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com IA generativa e copilots personalizados .
  • Vivência com MLOps , DataOps ou automação inteligente.
  • Experiência em Projetos corporativos de transformação digital .
  • Inglês técnico para leitura, documentação e acompanhamento de roadmaps de produto.
  • Disponibilidade para presença semanal em Guarulhos – SP .

Perfil esperado:

  • Profissional com visão sistêmica e perfil de liderança técnica , capaz de unir estratégia e execução.
  • Autonomia e proatividade para atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e em evolução constante.
  • Paixão por tecnologia Microsoft e inovação com IA.
  • Boa comunicação, colaboração e clareza ao traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas.

title: Senior C/C++ engineer with Python
description:
Project Description:

Founded in 1984, our client is one of the world's leading provider of lithography systems for the semiconductor industry, manufacturing complex machines that are critical to the production of integrated circuits or chips. The client has its R&D and manufacturing operations in The Netherlands.

Luxoft is currently searching to augment the Development & Engineering Department with a talented software engineer to design and implement embedded software for systems among the highest precision ever produced in the world.


Responsibilities:

  • As a software engineer, you will be working on Linux server applications for metrology components and on complex algorithms application software. You will be working with electrical engineers, mechatronic engineers and system engineers to define the software requirements.
  • A team of about 10 people consisting of a team lead, a sw architect, a few senior developers. After your SW design is approved you are responsible for implementing the design in Python & C for new modules.
  • During testing, you will collect the necessary data so you can write a test report.
  • The development environment is Red Hat Linux, execution environment is Wind River Linux. The software release driving a client machine is 40 million lines of code. Client SW teams work in various modes such as Agile and SAFE.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • We are looking for colleagues with at least 5 years of development experience.
  • Python: application coding
  • Linux (one of more of the following): familiar with command line tools, makefile, git, shell and python scripting
  • Embedded C and C++: understanding and maintaining legacy code. Adding new features while keeping compliance with established architecture.
  • Version control using command line is also required - Git, Clear Case and SVN, in this order of priority.


Languages:

  • English: C1 Advanced

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the opportunity:

Work Model :Remote

Location :Brazil/ Latam

  • Elixir OR Ruby + React, Typescript, NodeJS, etc - If candidates have either/or experience with just Elixir or just Ruby, please ensure they have front end AND back end experience.

What You Get To Do Every Day

- Produce high-quality, performant, and testable code that directly contributes to company-wide initiatives

- Develop using interesting technologies — Elixir, Ruby, React, TypeScript, GraphQL, Kafka, AWS/Lambda, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB

- Have significant input into technical decisions that will shape the future of our software systems

- Learn something new, whether it’s a new software design pattern or new initiative to push the company forward

- Review pull requests and provide constructive feedback to your peers

- Pair up with a team member to work together on features

- Deploy user-facing code to production


Skills/Experience

- 5+ years professional software development experience

- Fluency with either Elixir or Ruby

- Proficient with the latest versions of ECMAScript (JavaScript) as well as HTML and CSS

- Experience with React and common tools used in the wider React ecosystem, such as Node.js and npm

- Familiarity with common programming tools such as IDEs, RESTful APIs, Git repositories, TypeScript, version control software, and remote deployment tools

- Familiarity with event-based architectures, database fundamentals, and GraphQL

- Enthusiasm for solving problems for our users with technology

- Curiosity about retail/e-commerce, the high-end consignment market, and/or how to create a sustainable, circular economy for luxury goods






Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. title: Senior-Principal .NET Engineer
description:
Project Description:

Small team of expert level engineers to deliver changes across multiple services related to arbitrage.


Primary Stack: .NET, Kafka, MSSQL, Azure


Responsibilities:

- Collaborate with Portfolio managers and external teams

- Derive requirements and match it with architecture solutions

- Develop, test and deploy applications

- L3 support of end users and business


Mandatory Skills Description:

• Independent mindset, passion for technology, and an appetite for taking ownership, learning new technologies, and building innovative products.

• Minimum 5 years of development experience in financial services or technology industries.

• Full lifecycle experience including requirements gathering, implementation, testing, release, and support.

• Strong technical and development skills in cross-platform environment, preferably in C#

• Experience in Cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP) experience involving stateless and serverless solutions, event-driven architecture and cost optimization

• Experience in IaC development with Terraform/OpenTofu/Bicep/Pulumi

• Experience in container technologies (e.g., Docker, Podman) and container orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker Swarm).

• Experience with SQL development, preferably in a SQL Server environment.

• Exposure to multi-threaded programming concepts.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Strong team player.

• Bachelor's degree in computer science or engineering.

• .NET Core and Entity Framework Core.


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

• Knowledge of arbitrage strategies

• Experience with various financial products such as equities, derivatives, fixed income, etc., and related terminology.

• Experience working with market data (e.g. Bloomberg APIs, etc.).

• Experience with containerization and orchestrators.

• Experience with Test Driven Development.

• Experience with profiling and performance tuning techniques throughout the entire stack.

• Experience with NoSQL databases, including document databases and graph databases.

• Angular experience.


Languages:

English: C1 Advanced

title: Omnistudio Developer
description:
Salesforce Developer – OmniStudio & Communications Cloud


The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and delivering scalable and high‑quality Salesforce solutions within a digital transformation project in the telecommunications industry. You will work with OmniStudio, Salesforce Communications Cloud, and core Salesforce technologies to build optimized business processes. You will test your code, ensure quality through best practices, and collaborate in Agile environments.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement scalable solutions using OmniStudio (OmniScripts, FlexCards, DataRaptors, Integration Procedures).
  • Build and configure applications within Salesforce Communications Cloud (formerly Vlocity CPQ/EPC).
  • Participate in the development of telecom business processes such as quote‑to‑order , customer onboarding , and service provisioning .
  • Write clear, maintainable, and high‑quality code using Apex , LWC , and Salesforce configuration tools.
  • Support integration development using REST, SOAP, JSON, XML .
  • Collaborate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, estimation, and reviews.
  • Perform unit testing and provide support throughout SIT and UAT cycles.
  • Document technical specifications, solution designs, and deployment guidelines.
  • Contribute to CI/CD workflows using tools such as Copado, Git, Jenkins, Ant .


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands‑on experience with Salesforce development .
  • 2+ years of experience with OmniStudio development.
  • Strong experience with:
  • OmniScripts, FlexCards, DataRaptors, Integration Procedures
  • Salesforce configuration, Apex , and LWC
  • Salesforce Communications Cloud (Vlocity CPQ & EPC)
  • Experience integrating systems using REST/SOAP APIs and working with JSON/XML formats.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools (Copado, Git, Jenkins, Ant).
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments (SAFe Agile preferred).
  • Strong debugging, analytical, and troubleshooting skills.


Preferred Certifications

  • Salesforce Platform Developer I
  • OmniStudio Developer Certification
  • Salesforce Industries CPQ Developer (nice to have)

title: Software Engineer
description:
Nós somos a Bring IT!


Somos uma empresa de serviços profissionais em rápido crescimento e altamente dinâmica, levando transformação digital a clientes em todo o mundo. Desde o lançamento de produtos no mercado até o aumento da produtividade com a tecnologia e os processos certos, o trabalho que realizamos está transformando a maneira como as pessoas trabalham.

Para chegar lá, estamos construindo uma equipe global e diversa, capaz de enfrentar alguns dos desafios mais complexos do nosso tempo. Chamamos essa abordagem única de “360 Success”.


Somos reconhecidos como uma das empresas que mais crescem e têm mais sucesso no ranking Inc. 5000 dos Estados Unidos, e estamos abrindo novos escritórios pelo mundo para continuar crescendo, explorando e diversificando. Com mais de 10 reconhecimentos de parceiros, seguimos expandindo nossa presença nos mercados digitais.

Junte-se ao nosso Dream Team


A equipe Bring IT conta com mais de 300 profissionais espalhados por diversos países. Entendemos que grandes tecnologias começam com grandes talentos e com a diversidade de pensamento.

Nosso negócio é construído sobre conexão, trabalho em equipe e paixão pelo que fazemos. Esses valores moldam nossa cultura todos os dias — e estamos em busca de talentos que queiram gerar impacto no mundo.

Na Bring IT, você pode construir uma carreira gratificante, pois estamos comprometidos em apoiar seu crescimento profissional e pessoal.


Como Engenheiro(a) De Software Sênior, Você Irá

  • Orientar e dar suporte técnico a outros Engenheiros de Software.
  • Apoiar o time de desenvolvimento nas atividades do dia a dia.
  • Colaborar diretamente com clientes ou com suas equipes de desenvolvimento, oferecendo orientação e treinamento.
  • Conduzir análise, design, codificação, avaliação, modificação, testes e implementação de scripts e novas funcionalidades no NetSuite ERP.
  • Desenvolver customizações dentro do NetSuite para dar suporte a processos de negócios críticos.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Gerar documentação detalhada de processos, incluindo testes de produto, dados, fluxogramas, diagramas, layouts, comentários de código e outros materiais técnicos.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento NetSuite (scripts, workflows, relatórios).
  • Domínio em JavaScript.
  • Compreensão de arquitetura de sistemas, design orientado a objetos, frameworks web e padrões de desenvolvimento.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias SDLC (Software Development Lifecycle).
  • Proficiência em resolução e tratamento de erros e debugging.
  • Experiência com ambientes de desenvolvimento integrados (IDEs), sistemas de controle de versão, ferramentas de testes unitários e gestão de defeitos.
  • Experiência com Webservices (SOAP e REST).
  • Conhecimento em GIT.


Habilidades e Qualificações Desejadas

  • Experiência com NetSuite.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação.
  • Graduação em Contabilidade (CPA) é um diferencial.
  • Experiência em consultoria de TI ou de negócios.
  • Proficiência em inglês.
  • Certificações NetSuite.
  • Habilidades funcionais, de implementação e liderança serão consideradas um diferencial.

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Adobe Developer  (AEM) | Specialist

Você fará parte da Compass UOL, uma empresa global que integra o grupo AI/R Comany ! Atuamos na transformação digital de organizações, ajudando-as a inovar e alcançar resultados de impacto.

Desenvolvemos plataformas digitais e soluções que impulsionam negócios, promovendo eficiência, escalabilidade e experiências diferenciadas.

Com foco em atrair e desenvolver os melhores talentos, criamos oportunidades que transformam vidas e reforçam o papel positivo da tecnologia na sociedade


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Atuar no desenvolvimento e evolução de soluções baseadas em Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), com foco em componentes escaláveis e integrações com plataformas digitais do Serasa;
  • Apoiar decisões arquiteturais e garantir aderência às boas práticas recomendadas pela Adobe;
  • Atuar próximo aos times de negócio e tecnologia, assegurando qualidade técnica, performance e estabilidade das entregas;
  • Desenvolver componentes, funcionalidades e integrações utilizando tecnologias relacionadas ao ecossistema AEM;
  • Implementar integrações com APIs REST, garantindo segurança, eficiência e resiliência;
  • Trabalhar com configuração, otimização e boas práticas de cache utilizando Dispatcher;
  • Dar suporte técnico aos times envolvidos, atuando como referência técnica e orientando boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Contribuir para a evolução contínua da plataforma digital, colaborando com squads multidisciplinares;
  • Integrar soluções do ecossistema Adobe, quando aplicável, incluindo Target, Analytics e Adobe Experience Platform (AEP).



REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Experiência comprovada com Adobe Experience Manager (AEM);
  • Domínio das linguagens e tecnologias Java, HTML e JavaScript;
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de aplicações;
  • Experiência com integrações utilizando APIs REST;
  • Conhecimento em configuração e uso de Dispatcher e estratégias de cache;
  • Conhecimento em Adobe Target (desejável);
  • Conhecimento em Adobe Analytics (desejável);
  • Conhecimento em Adobe Experience Platform – AEP (desejável);
  • Experiência prévia em projetos de grande escala e alta disponibilidade (desejável).

title: Legal Architect (Remote)
description:
About Lovie

Lovie is an AI-powered platform that helps anyone, anywhere launch a US company.

We build for solopreneurs, creators, and vibe coders — people who move fast, think independently, and use AI as a creative partner.

We’re a small, remote-first team building calm, powerful infrastructure for the next generation of internet builders.

What This Role Is

You are the legal architect of our company formation engine.

Your job is to turn complex US legal requirements into clean, automated, AI-native systems that feel simple and frictionless to founders.

You will own the accuracy, structure, and scalability of our formation service.

What You Absolutely NeedDeep, Hands-On US Formation Experience

You must have real operational experience with:

  • LLC vs C-Corp structures (pros, cons, founder fit)
  • Delaware and Wyoming state filing processes
  • EIN applications and IRS processes
  • BOI reporting requirements
  • Registered Agent requirements
  • Operating Agreements, Bylaws, and core post-formation compliance

You’ve filed, managed, and maintained entities yourself. This cannot be theoretical knowledge.

Systems & Automation Mindset

You:

  • Break complex legal processes into clean, logical workflows
  • Think in systems, not tasks
  • Document clearly and structure information well
  • Obsess over eliminating friction

If something is repetitive, your instinct is to automate it.

Strong Vibe Coding Energy (Non-Negotiable)

You don’t need to be a software engineer — but you think like one.

You:

  • Use AI tools daily
  • Prototype solutions before escalating
  • Enjoy no-code / low-code tools
  • Treat AI as a collaborator, not a novelty
  • Care about flow, elegance, and simplicity

You believe great infrastructure should feel invisible.

Clear Communication

You can:

  • Explain complex legal topics in plain English
  • Write structured documentation
  • Operate effectively in async, remote environments
Lovie Culture

We are:

Life-First.

We optimize for energy, not hours. Autonomy is default.

Calm Builders.

We reject hustle culture. We move deliberately and ship thoughtfully.

Low Ego, High Ownership.

No politics. No posturing. Just strong operators building clean systems.

AI-Native.

We don’t bolt AI on top. We build with it from the beginning.

Vibe Coder Friendly.

  • We value intuition, speed, experimentation, and creative problem-solving.

title: Senior AI/ML Developer
description:
About The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior AI/ML Developer to lead the technical development of an Industrial RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) solution for a major US-based client. The project addresses a critical challenge: transitioning 25 years of historical lab reports from SharePoint into an intelligent, GenAI-powered knowledge retrieval system.

You will be responsible for building a two-phase solution, starting with a Proof of Concept (POC) for a Pricing Analyst Agent and evolving into a Production-Ready Conversational AI Agent. This role focuses on automating knowledge retrieval, preserving institutional expertise, and enhancing the accuracy of fluid design processes through scalable AWS architectures.


Responsibilities

  • Develop and validate robust AI architectures leveraging AWS Infrastructure, specifically Amazon Bedrock and SageMaker.
  • Create GenAI pipelines and multi-agent workflows using AWS Step Functions, Lambda, and EventBridge.
  • Design platforms for processing massive volumes of unstructured data (text, image, audio, and video) integrated with RAG patterns.
  • Build interactive front-ends and AI dashboards using Streamlit for demos and operational workflows.
  • Implement best practices for AI governance, security, and observability using AWS IAM and CloudWatch.
  • Fine-tune pricing normalization and data retrieval to reduce bid risk and improve decision accuracy.


Required Qualifications

  • Good English communication skills (mandatory for direct collaboration with US stakeholders).
  • Proven hands-on experience building real-world GenAI applications using commercial LLMs.
  • Deep technical knowledge of the AWS ecosystem, including Serverless architectures and AI-specific services.
  • Strong experience building intelligent pipelines and event-oriented architectures.
  • Ability to design, test, and evaluate prompt engineering strategies and agentic frameworks.
  • Experience handling complex, unstructured data sources at scale.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with industrial-scale data migrations (SharePoint to Cloud).
  • Background in data science, specifically related to pricing normalization or cost baselines.
  • AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty or AWS Certified AI Practitioner certifications.

title: Crypto Client & Operations Specialist (Private Segment)
description:
About the Company

CryptoHub is an international crypto infrastructure and services group working with private clients, digital asset operators, and blockchain-based platforms across the Middle East, Asia, and emerging markets.

The company focuses on structured execution, operational reliability, and long-term relationships with high-value crypto participants. As part of its expansion into Latin America, CryptoHub is building a dedicated presence in Brazil to support private clients and regional operations.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Crypto Client & Operations Specialist to support operational workflows and private client coordination in Brazil.

This role sits between operations, client support, and relationship management. You will work with crypto-native, financially sophisticated clients and ensure that onboarding, ongoing coordination, and operational execution are handled with precision and discretion.

This position does not involve trading, portfolio management, or investment advisory activities.

Key Responsibilities
  • Coordinate operational workflows for private crypto clients
  • Support client onboarding, documentation, and ongoing operational requests
  • Monitor crypto-related activity using internal systems and blockchain explorers
  • Act as a point of coordination between clients, internal teams, and service providers
  • Maintain structured records, reports, and operational documentation
  • Identify and escalate operational or compliance-related issues when required
Requirements
  • 2+ years of experience in crypto operations, Web3 support, or digital asset services
  • Practical understanding of blockchain transactions, wallets, and on-chain workflows
  • Experience working with high-value clients or confidential operations is a strong advantage
  • Strong attention to detail and process-oriented mindset
  • Ability to operate professionally in a private, relationship-driven environment
  • Fluent English; Portuguese is required
What We Offer
  • Exposure to private crypto clients and international operations
  • A discreet, professional working environment with clear responsibilities
  • Long-term career path within crypto infrastructure and client operations
  • Compensation structure aligned with senior specialist profiles in Brazil
Compensation

Base Salary: USD 80,000 – 110,000 gross per year

Token Allocation: Discretionary, performance-based allocation

Legacy: Long-term role with progression into senior private operations or regional coordination positions

title: Software Engineer
description:
Project Description:


  • We are building a team to work on the FreeBSD Performance Monitoring Counter (PMC) framework, including hwmon, libpmc, and pmcstat.
  • The project includes development, testing, and cooperation with the upstream FreeBSD open-source community to integrate new features into FreeBSD.


Responsibilities:

  • Develop and improve parts of the FreeBSD PMC framework (hwmon, libpmc, pmcstat)
  • Investigate and fix performance and monitoring issues in the FreeBSD kernel
  • Work with the upstream FreeBSD community and integrate changes into mainline FreeBSD
  • Support performance monitoring tools for modern AMD (Zen era) hardware
  • Participate in code reviews and technical discussions


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 7 years of experience in relevant technical areas
  • Strong knowledge of FreeBSD kernel architecture and internals
  • Excellent C programming skills
  • Strong understanding of x86 microarchitecture
  • Very good knowledge of performance monitoring on modern x86 systems


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

  • Previous contributions to upstream FreeBSD kernel code
  • Experience with AMD Zen performance monitoring technologies (PMC, IBS, etc.)

title: Customer Success Agent (Technical, 24/7 Operations)
description:
Customer Success Agent (Technical, 24/7 Operations)


TG Lab is a technology company powering some of the biggest winners in sports betting and online casino products. We provide player account management and engagement technology to industry leaders such as Stake.com, Belgium National Lottery, Betsson Group , and many others. Our innovative yet practical solutions fuel world-class real-money wagering technology that supports over 1 million players. Our iGaming software is designed for distribution to casino and sportsbook operators across the EU, USA , and Asia.


We’re looking for a Customer Success Manager (Technical) to join our 24/7 operations team, which operates at the core of platform stability, partner communication, and incident handling. In this role, you’ll work on the frontline monitoring platform health, investigating issues, and coordinating real-time responses to ensure stable and reliable operations for our partners. This role is about real-time reaction, investigation, coordination, and clear communication.


Responsibilities:  


  • Actively monitor platform health and alerts during your shift and react to incidents in real time
  • Investigate partner-raised issues and perform first-level technical analysis using logs and monitoring dashboards
  • Communicate clearly with partners during incidents, outages, and escalations
  • Own issues throughout their full life cycle: detection, investigation, coordination, and resolution
  • Create and manage Jira tickets and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams
  • Provide transparent updates internally and externally
  • Identify recurring issues and risks that may impact platform stability
  • Maintain accurate documentation and structured internal communication


Requirements:


  • Junior to early-mid level profile 
  • Strong written and verbal English skills
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-responsibility environment
  • Logical, analytical thinker with a structured approach to problem solving
  • Technically curious and comfortable working with system behavior, logs, and monitoring tools
  • Experience or familiarity with Jira, Slack, or similar tools
  • Able to work shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays, as part of a 24/7 rotation
  • Calm under pressure and confident handling incidents and escalations


Things we consider as an advantage:


  • Experience in Customer Support, Customer Success, Technical Support, NOC, or Operations
  • Experience with monitoring tools
  • Exposure to SaaS, platform-based products, or iGaming
  • Basic understanding of web technologies, APIs, or backend systems


Working with us implies:


  • Memorable company parties and social activities like team buildings and monthly birthday celebrations.
  • Working in a company with a global culture, experience, and reach.
  • Working on-site in our modern, bright, and comfortable office space located in downtown Foz do Iguaçu, with a great working atmosphere, a collaborative team of amazing people, and open-minded managers.
  • Opportunities to build valuable skills, work with unique and interesting projects for the sports industry, express and implement your ideas and grow your career.


The monthly salary range will depend on the selected candidate's experience and skills.

We will contact only shortlisted candidates.

title: Designer júnior
description:
Buscamos uma pessoa para ocupar o posto de designer júnior com foco em motion design, que vai atuar no desenvolvimento de conteúdos animados aplicados à comunicação digital e institucional.


A pessoa contratada atuará como prestadora de serviços criativos, desenvolvendo peças de motion design em colaboração com a equipe de criação. A atuação será orientada por briefings e diretrizes estratégicas, preservando autonomia técnica na execução.


A posição exige olhar atento a detalhes, interesse por narrativa visual e vontade de transformar conteúdos complexos em peças claras, didáticas e visualmente consistentes com a identidade da marca.


Diversidade, equidade e inclusão

Adotamos políticas afirmativas de diversidade, equidade e inclusão em nossos processos seletivos. Buscamos ampliar a representatividade racial e territorial no mercado de comunicação e design, incentivando candidaturas de mulheres negras/indígenas, e profissionais localizadas nas regiões Norte e Nordeste do Brasil.

A seleção seguirá critérios técnicos e profissionais, considerando a diversidade como valor prioritário, estratégico e estruturante.


Objetivo da posição

  • Desenvolver peças de motion design para diferentes plataformas digitais, apoiando estratégias de comunicação por meio de conteúdos animados claros, didáticos e visualmente consistentes com a identidade da marca a ser trabalhada.
  • Atuar de forma multidisciplinar, colaborando em projetos gráficos e planejamento e na criação de apresentações institucionais e ajustes de materiais gráficos diversos.
  • Contribuir para projetos audiovisuais com foco em animações curtas, vídeos explicativos e conteúdos digitais.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Apoiar de forma multidisciplinar a equipe de design na elaboração de projetos gráficos, apresentações e ajustes.
  • Desenvolver animações e vídeos curtos para redes sociais, campanhas digitais, apresentações institucionais e conteúdos educativos;
  • Criar motions a partir de layouts estáticos (cards, infográficos, apresentações, peças editoriais);
  • Apoiar edição básica de vídeo (cortes, ajustes de ritmo, inserção de legendas e elementos gráficos);
  • Adaptar peças para diferentes formatos e plataformas (Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, apresentações, landing pages);
  • Garantir consistência visual e aderência à identidade da marca e aos guias de estilo;
  • Apoiar a equipe de design na elaboração e ajustes de materiais gráficos diversos;
  • Organizar arquivos, versões e entregas conforme fluxos acordados;
  • Trabalhar de forma integrada com equipes de conteúdo, social media, design gráfico e estratégia;


Requisitos técnicos obrigatórios

Formação em andamento ou concluída em Design Gráfico, Design Digital, Audiovisual, Comunicação Visual ou áreas correlatas;

Domínio intermediário de:

  • After Effects (essencial);
  • Premiere Pro (ou equivalente para edição básica);
  • Illustrator e/ou Photoshop para preparação de assets;
  • PowerPoint

Noções de:

  • Tipografia animada;
  • Ritmo, timing e hierarquia visual;
  • Formatos e especificações para redes sociais;

Portfólio com exemplos de motion design (acadêmicos ou autorais são bem-vindos).


Requisitos desejáveis (não eliminatórios)

  • Noções de storytelling visual e narrativa audiovisual;
  • Incorporar feedbacks de forma ágil e construtiva.
  • Familiaridade com animações explicativas, vídeos institucionais ou conteúdos educativos;
  • Conhecimento básico de: Animação de infográficos; Templates animados; Figma (para leitura e adaptação de layouts);
  • Interesse por tendências de design, vídeo e comunicação digital;
  • Experiência prévia em agência, estúdio ou projetos colaborativos.


Competências comportamentais esperadas

  • Organização e atenção a detalhes;
  • Capacidade de receber e aplicar feedback com maturidade;
  • Curiosidade e disposição para aprender continuamente;
  • Responsabilidade com prazos e entregas;
  • Comunicação clara e colaborativa;
  • Capacidade de atuar em múltiplos projetos simultaneamente, com orientação.


Entregáveis típicos

  • Vídeos animados curtos (15s a 60s);
  • Animações de cards e carrosséis;
  • Vinhetas e aberturas simples;
  • Animações de dados, textos e infográficos;
  • Desdobramentos animados de campanhas e apresentações.


Como o portfólio será avaliado

Serão considerados:

  • Clareza conceitual;
  • Domínio técnico;
  • Coerência visual;
  • Criatividade e capacidade de resolução de problemas;
  • Adequação ao formato digital.


Desenvolvimento e crescimento

  • Aprendizado contínuo em projetos reais;
  • Interação com profissionais mais experientes da área criativa;
  • Evolução técnica em motion design aplicado à comunicação estratégica;
  • Exposição a diferentes formatos, públicos e narrativas.

title: Representante de desenvolvimento de vendas
description:
SDR Pleno/Sênior – HarmonizaPRO


APENAS APLIQUE SE VOCÊ TEM EXPERIÊNCIA COMO SDR E RESULTADOS COMPROVADOS


Esse cargo exige alta energia, ambição, excelente oratória, organização e disciplina para seguir processos. Não buscamos alguém que \"quer aprender a ser SDR\", buscamos alguém que já domina a função e quer crescer em um ambiente de alta performance.


Sobre a vaga:

Você será responsável por qualificar leads inbound (vindos de tráfego pago e indicações) e acompanhá-los até o comparecimento na call com o closer. Também terá uma carteira de clientes para reativação, garantindo uma agenda sempre cheia.

Seu papel é fundamental: você é a primeira impressão da HarmonizaPRO para o cliente. Precisa identificar oportunidade, gerar conexão e conduzir o lead com maestria até a próxima etapa.


Responsabilidades:

  • Qualificação de leads via ligação (boa parte do processo é por telefone)
  • Acompanhamento e follow-up até o comparecimento em call
  • Reativação de base de clientes
  • Atualização rigorosa do CRM
  • Participação em dailys, 1:1s com gestor e weeklys


Sobre a HarmonizaPRO:

Somos a maior aceleradora comercial para clínicas de harmonização facial do Brasil. Fundamos a empresa em 2021 e saímos de 2 founders para 43 pessoas, com sede em Balneário Camboriú. Nosso objetivo é ser o maior ecossistema de marketing e vendas para clínicas do mundo.


Remuneração:

  • Salário fixo inicial: R$ 3.000, com aumento de $500 após 3 meses de metas batidas, chegando num teto de R$5.000 de fixo.
  • Variável agressivo baseado em performance
  • Média salarial inicial: R$ 6.000 a R$ 10.000/mês
  • Potendo chegar até R$ 12.000+/mês para quem entrega resultado acima da média


Detalhes da vaga:

  • Local: Remoto (com oportunidade e preferência para migração ao presencial em Balneário Camboriú — a ser discutido na fase de contratação)
  • Regime: PJ
  • Horário: Integral
  • Ferramentas: CRM, Meet, WhatsApp, planilhas e plataformas de gestão comercial

title: Especialista jurídico
description:
Vaga afirmativa para PCD e 40+


Especialista Jurídico


Qualidade para Vida - Esta é a visão de negócio da GMReis, que há mais de 25 anos desenvolve, produz e comercializa sua linha de produtos, classificada em próteses ortopédicas.

A inovação tecnológica aliada à qualidade dos produtos são os valores buscados diariamente na GMReis para que a expectativa dos clientes, médicos e pacientes, seja plenamente atendida com segurança e eficácia.

A GMReis está sediada em Campinas/SP em uma área de 6.000 m², dentro de um moderno parque tecnológico, com equipamentos de produção e análise metrológica de última geração, e uma área limpa ISO classe 8 de 800 m² onde são fabricados enxertos ósseos e implantes biorreabsorvíveis.


Atuação Presencial


Horário: Segunda a Quinta 07:30h as 17:30 e sexta 07:30h as 16:30h.


Área: Jurídico

Reporte: CEO

Regime: CLT


Descrição do Cargo

Atuar como Especialista Jurídico, prestando apoio técnico direto ao CEO, com foco na leitura, análise e revisão de contratos empresariais, inclusive em língua inglesa, contribuindo para a mitigação de riscos e suporte à tomada de decisão da Diretoria.

Atuar como ponto focal jurídico da empresa, realizando análises jurídicas preliminares e intermediando, de forma técnica, as demandas junto a escritórios e consultorias jurídicas externas.


Principais Atividades:

  • Ler, analisar e revisar contratos empresariais, inclusive contratos redigidos em inglês, identificando riscos, inconsistências e pontos de atenção;


  • Prestar suporte jurídico direto ao CEO em temas contratuais e decisões estratégicas;


  • Atuar como interface técnica junto a escritórios e consultorias jurídicas externas, alinhando escopo, análises e encaminhamentos;


  • Realizar análises jurídicas preliminares nas áreas contratual, societária, tributária e trabalhista, direcionando demandas às consultorias especializadas quando necessário;


  • Acompanhar prazos, vigências, renovações e aditivos contratuais, avaliando impactos jurídicos e financeiros;


  • Contribuir para a padronização de instrumentos contratuais, em conjunto com o jurídico externo;


  • Garantir controle, organização e rastreabilidade dos contratos e demandas jurídicas da empresa;


  • Apoiar áreas internas em temas jurídicos, conforme diretrizes da Diretoria.


Requisitos:

  • Formação superior completa em Direito;


  • OAB ativa;


  • Experiência prática com contratos empresariais;


  • Capacidade comprovada de leitura, interpretação e análise de contratos em inglês;


  • Vivência em interface com escritórios e consultorias jurídicas externas;


  • Perfil técnico, analítico e criterioso;


  • Discrição, ética profissional e capacidade de atuação próxima à alta liderança.


  • Residir em Campinas ou Sumaré, Paulínia, Hortolândia ou Valinhos.


Benefícios:

  • Vale Refeição
  • Vale Alimentação
  • Vale transporte ou auxílio combustível
  • Convênio médico coparticipativo (para o colaborador (a)
  • Convênio odontológico para colaborador e dependentes
  • Parceria com a faculdade Esamc descontos de até 50% na mensalidade para graduações e tecnólogos e 20% para MBA.

title: Senior Business/System Analyst (Disaster Recovery)
description:
Product Overview:

Vuori is re-defining what athletic apparel looks like: built to move and sweat in but designed with a casual aesthetic to transition into everyday life. Our high-energy, fast-paced office environment is reflected in the clothes we make. We aim to inspire others to take on all aspects of their lives with clarity, enthusiasm, and purpose…. while having a lot of fun along the way. We are proud to be an outlet for the opportunity of personal growth and success.


Overview

We are seeking a contract Business Analyst to support the development and execution of our Disaster Recovery (DR) Program. This role will help establish structure, documentation, and repeatable processes to ensure our DR efforts are organized, testable, and aligned with business needs.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop the overall structure and framework for the Disaster Recovery Program, including roles, responsibilities, and governance.
  • Create and refine documentation such as DR runbooks, process flows, and system recovery procedures.
  • Partner with technical teams to capture system dependencies, failover steps, testing requirements, and validation criteria.
  • Build templates, standards, and repeatable processes to drive consistency across DR documentation.
  • Coordinate project tasks, track progress, and support cross-functional alignment to ensure milestones are met.
  • Facilitate workshops and gather requirements from subject-matter experts.
  • Define DR test planning, evidence capture, post-test reviews, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Ensure documentation aligns with internal standards and compliance requirements (e.g., SOX, SOC2).


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Program Coordinator, or similar role.
  • Experience supporting Disaster Recovery, Business Continuity, or technology resilience programs.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills with the ability to translate complex technical inputs into clear, structured outputs.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with infrastructure, applications, and security teams.
  • Proficiency with tools such as Confluence, Jira, Microsoft 365, and diagramming solutions.
  • Advanced spoken English level (B2–C1 or higher).


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Azure, SaaS vendor DR models, or hybrid cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as SOX, SOC2, or ISO 22301.
  • Prior involvement in DR tabletop exercises


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), and a flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: FreeBSD Engineer
description:
Project Description:

  • We are building a team to work on the FreeBSD Performance Monitoring Counter (PMC) framework, including hwmon, libpmc, and pmcstat.
  • The project includes development, testing, and cooperation with the upstream FreeBSD open-source community to integrate new features into FreeBSD.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and improve parts of the FreeBSD PMC framework (hwmon, libpmc, pmcstat)
  • Investigate and fix performance and monitoring issues in the FreeBSD kernel
  • Work with the upstream FreeBSD community and integrate changes into mainline FreeBSD
  • Support performance monitoring tools for modern AMD (Zen era) hardware
  • Participate in code reviews and technical discussions


Skills Description:

Must have:

  • 7 years of experience in relevant technical areas
  • Strong knowledge of FreeBSD kernel architecture and internals
  • Excellent C programming skills
  • Strong understanding of x86 microarchitecture
  • Very good knowledge of performance monitoring on modern x86 systems

Nice-to-Have:

  • Previous contributions to upstream FreeBSD kernel code
  • Experience with AMD Zen performance monitoring technologies (PMC, IBS, etc.)

Languages:

English: B2 Upper Intermediate


Seniority: Senior


If you`re interesting in the role, send your profile (CV) in English and contact to me.


¡Thank you!

title: Partner Lead - Creator & IRL Business
description:
The position can be based anywhere in Latin America (Fully Remote).


About TVU Networks

TVU Networks is redefining how live content is created and distributed, from global broadcasters and sports leagues to the fastest-growing creator ecosystem.

As live streaming evolves from studios to the streets, from TV to creators, TVU provides the infrastructure powering reliable live video anywhere, trusted by major media organizations and top streamers worldwide.

The next phase of growth is expanding our creator and IRL ecosystem globally, and LATAM is a key frontier.



Role Overview

We are looking for a strong Partner Lead to build and scale TVU’s content creator ecosystem across Latin America, Spain and Portugal.

This is a highly entrepreneurial role focused on developing partnerships with agencies, creators, production partners, and resellers, while driving revenue growth across hardware, connectivity, and self-served SaaS solutions.

Based in Latin America (fully remote), reporting to the VP of Content Creator Unit, you will act as the local engine of growth, helping partners succeed, unlocking new markets, reducing operational friction, and ensuring creators can adopt TVU seamlessly.

This role sits at the intersection of sales, partnerships, market development, and community building.


What You'll Do

  • Recruit and activate partners (agencies, resellers, production, creator networks)
  • Drive revenue across packs, data, support and mobile apps.
  • Support partners through deals, logistics, and deployments
  • Build relationships with top creators and emerging talent
  • Identify growth opportunities and execute locally
  • Help solve operational and market entry challenges
  • Collaborate with global partner and regional teams


Success Looks Like

  • Strong partner network across key LATAM, Spain & Portugal markets
  • New creator and partner deals closed
  • Growing regional revenue contribution
  • Clear pipeline and local momentum
  • Partners actively selling and advocating for TVU


Who You Are

  • Entrepreneurial and hands-on
  • Strong network in media, creators, streaming, or tech
  • Comfortable owning revenue outcomes
  • Fluent Spanish and English (Portuguese a big plus)
  • Thrive in fast, ambiguous environments


Why This Role

  • Remote position anywhere in Latin America with high autonomy
  • Be part of a fast-paced, fast-growing Silicon Valley company with 300+ team members worldwide
  • Work at the center of the rapidly evolving creator economy
  • You’ll help shape how the next generation of live creators operates, with real ownership, global visibility, and direct impact on growth



Please note that your application will only be considered if your CV and email are sent directly to:  


TVU Networks is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and encourage those who meet the qualifications to apply.


Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Who We Are


MAVI is on a mission to globalize the finance and accounting function by connecting the best talent in the world with high-performing US companies. We’re building the world’s largest network of top-tier finance talent, using an AI-powered platform for sourcing, vetting & matching, and disrupting a legacy $100Bn+ industry.


We’re excited to be hiring a Talent Acquisition Specialist to help grow MAVI’s talent network from the hundreds today to millions in the years ahead. Talent acquisition is at the heart of MAVI’s platform, and we’re looking for someone who is creative, resourceful, and data-driven to help us build scalable ways of sourcing and vetting top finance talent across the globe.


You’ll be joining as one of the first dedicated members of our Talent Acquisition (TA) team, working closely with colleagues and founders to shape and expand our network. This is a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact, build processes from the ground up, and directly influence how we grow.


What You’ll Do:


  • Lead and support end-to-end talent acquisition.
  • Explore, establish, and refine channels for talent sourcing at scale across LATAM (primarily), APAC, and other regions, in close partnership with the engineering team.
  • Build proprietary sourcing networks in key regions, using creative strategies to attract exceptional talent.
  • Guide and improve the vetting process to ensure only the most qualified finance & accounting professionals join MAVI’s network.
  • Define and track key performance metrics for sourcing and vetting to continuously enhance processes and uphold high standards of quality.
  • Collaborate closely with the TA team, founders, and engineering team to introduce automation and efficiencies across sourcing, screening, and vetting.
  • Partner with the TA team and founders to shape the right distribution of skills and profiles in the talent pool, and source accordingly to meet these goals.
  • Consistently work towards meeting and surpassing monthly talent acquisition KPIs.
  • Act as a trusted thought partner to the founders on all aspects of talent acquisition.


What We’re Looking For:


  • 3-8+ years of end-to-end recruiting experience, with some leadership exposure being a plus.
  • Strong ability to source high-quality talent at scale using both active and passive techniques, ideally across multiple regions (with APAC and LATAM experience being especially valuable).
  • Skilled in vetting and interviewing talent, serving as an early filter to assess candidates against defined criteria.
  • Experience experimenting with and refining different sourcing channels and strategies.
  • Comfortable using data to guide sourcing and acquisition decisions, and setting KPIs to measure success.
  • Prior experience recruiting finance & accounting talent is a plus, though not essential.
  • Familiarity with key HR tools (e.g., LinkedIn, job boards, ATS platforms) to support efficient acquisition processes.
  • Ability to thrive in dynamic, fast-moving environments, with flexibility to adapt to change.
  • Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • A team player who is humble, driven, and passionate about delivering excellence in their work.


Why You Should Join Us:


  • Impact : You’re not just another cog in the machine; you’ll help build the talent acquisition motion ground up that powers the entire business.
  • No Bureaucracy : Work directly with founders, move fast, and own meaningful projects. We’re playing to win here. This is a startup and we’re looking for new ideas, bold moves, and scrappiness.
  • Competitive Pay : We believe in sharing the upside with those who build it.
  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere, but expect high velocity and deep collaboration.


Equal Opportunity Statement


At MAVI, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applicants of every background, identity, and life experience. Employment decisions are based on business needs, qualifications, and merit, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

You’ll be joining as one of the first dedicated members of our Talent Acquisition (TA) team, working closely with colleagues and founders to shape and expand our network. What You’ll Do:


  • Lead and support end-to-end talent acquisition.
  • Explore, establish, and refine channels for talent sourcing at scale across LATAM (primarily), APAC, and other regions, in close partnership with the engineering team.

  • Define and track key performance metrics for sourcing and vetting to continuously enhance processes and uphold high standards of quality.
  • Collaborate closely with the TA team, founders, and engineering team to introduce automation and efficiencies across sourcing, screening, and vetting.

  • 3-8+ years of end-to-end recruiting experience, with some leadership exposure being a plus.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
We are seeking a full-time, remote Senior AI Engineer with 7+ years of software development experience and a strong background building AI native software to join our U.S. client. You will provide leadership and expertise to advance strategic and technical goals of our client.

Our client is venture studio that surrounds industry subject matter experts with senior technical talent to build AI native software solving real-world problems.


Responsibilities

  • Provide strategic and technical expertise to AI-powered, engineering initiatives
  • Advise startups on AI product development using agentic AI, LLMs, and modern AI infrastructure
  • Develop software in conjunction with startup subject matter experts and engineering teams
  • Stay abreast of AI trends and advise colleagues and clients on emerging AI opportunities
  • Communicate across different stakeholder groups including executive, boards, technical, client and industry


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 7+ years of software development experience including AI engineering
  • Strong proficiency in Python
  • Deep experience in AI product development using agents, LLMs, and modern AI infrastructure
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent
  • Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and modern MLOps practices
  • Track record of deploying AI services in production
  • Strong grounding in cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Proven experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or within a broader team
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • University degree in a technical field


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Forensic Manager
description:
This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.


Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.


Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.


In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.


To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.


While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.


For more information, please see our video

title: Técnico de suporte
description:
Vaga de Técnico de Sustentação em nossa unidade de negócios de Supply Chain. Oportunidade de suporte , para trabalhar com o software Warehouse Advantage, Infios One (WMS) e com conjunto de softwares de terceiros, como: Sistema operacional Windows, SQL Server/Oracle, software de relatórios e impressões


Responsabilidades no día a día:

Atender usuários por telefone, e-mail ou tickets abertos nas ferramentas usadas pela empresa

Aplicar soluções consultivas e auxiliar na análise de problemas

Garantir a qualidade dos serviços prestados e atingimento do nível de serviço/satisfação acordado.

Consultar as documentações técnicas e fontes alternativas de informação, simulando/testando problemas no ambiente


Qualificação requeridas:


  • 2 anos de experiência em suporte técnico ao cliente
  • Superior Completo ou cursando a partir do 3º semestre em Ciências da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas afins.
  • Conhecimento básico em banco de dados.
  • Conhecimento em sistemas operacionais Windows e conceitos de rede
  • Perfil analítico, comunicativo, voltado para resolução de problemas
  • Fortes habilidades de atendimento ao cliente e capacidade de multitarefa
  • Capacidade de priorizar tarefas e auto gerenciá-las
  • Conhecimento básico em lógica de programação


Diferencial:


  • Inglês e/ou Espanhol.
  • Conhecimento em logística (WMS)
  • Experiência com programação de computadores e conhecimento básico de linguagens de programação de computadores
  • Experiência com sistemas operacionais e rede de computadores
  • Experiência ou conhecimento em soluções de gerenciamento da cadeia de suprimentos
  • Experiência com a plataforma Korber One e os aplicativos K.Motion Warehouse Advantage

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Senior Backend Engineer (Stripe & Fintech Specialist)

Contract: 6–12 months (with possibility of extension)

Engagement Model: Independent Contractor (PJ)


Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer with deep expertise in Stripe Connect to lead the evolution of a critical payment infrastructure.

This role will be responsible for architecting and implementing a robust Stripe Connect integration within a core Django API, supporting the migration from a legacy Ruby on Rails payment portal.

You will lead the end-to-end payment lifecycle - from onboarding and funds flow to webhook orchestration and complex business logic - ensuring scalability, security, and reliability across payment operations.


Core Responsibilities

  • Architect and implement Stripe Connect integrations (Standard, Express, or Custom) within a Django/Python environment

  • Lead migration of payment logic and data from a legacy Ruby on Rails application into a Django-based architecture
  • Integrate Stripe events with core backend workflows and business processes
  • Implement asynchronous processing using Celery and Redis for high-volume payment tasks

  • Build monitoring, alerting, and logging for payment flows (Datadog, Sentry, or similar tools)
  • Write comprehensive unit and integration tests, maintaining high test coverage


Technical Stack

Backend: Python 3.11+, Django 4.x, Django REST Framework (DRF)

Payments: Stripe (Connect, Billing, Webhooks)

Task Queue: Celery, Redis, RabbitMQ (Amazon MQ)

Database: PostgreSQL (Aurora Serverless v2)

Infrastructure: AWS (ECS Fargate, ElastiCache)


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong experience building production-grade payment systems
  • Deep understanding of Stripe Connect and marketplace payment architectures
  • Experience migrating legacy systems to modern backend frameworks
  • Solid knowledge of asynchronous architectures and event-driven systems
  • Strong ownership mindset and ability to lead complex backend initiatives

title: Full Stack Engineer (React.js / RoR)
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Full Stack Engineer with 3+ years of experience in React.js, TypeScript, and Ruby on Rails to join the core development team of our U.S. client. You will design, build, and deliver the best financial software on the planet!


Our client is a fintech company that provides commodities managers with task automation and timely insights on their trades, including risk exposure, positions, and profits and losses. With over 5 million trades on its SaaS platform, the company is an award-winning industry leader that counts some of the world's largest financial firms as customers. Our client is growing rapidly and is looking for smart, bold risk-takers to further its product strategy of market disruption and expansion.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and test new features for the clients next-gen trading platform
  • Write efficient, maintainable, and reusable code
  • Utilize AI tooling, such as Cursor and CodeRabbit, to accelerate software development
  • Participate in and support the full continuous testing and delivery pipeline
  • Join the engineering support rotation, assisting the Customer Success team
  • Write and maintain unit, integration, and feature tests
  • Review code and tests written by other team members
  • Identify and eliminate technical debt
  • Accept, act on, and provide feedback in a timely manner
  • Seek and provide timely technical assistance and clarification.
  • Collaborate with and mentor team members
  • Learn new technologies (and help your teammates learn them too)
  • Support the clients growth by contributing to open-source projects and representing the client within the developer community


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and teamwork skills
  • 3+ years of experience developing full stack applications with React.js and Ruby on Rails
  • Experience with TypeScript, SQL-compliant databases, Go, Python, or other open-source and commercial technologies, such as Kafka and RabbitMQ
  • Proficient in the use of AI tooling such as Cursor and GitHub CoPilot
  • Experience with high-volume, event-based system architectures and Agile software development practices
  • A self-disciplined, task-oriented approach to development, testing, and code structure
  • Desire to work in an environment that:
  • Embraces diversity
  • Maintains a client-centric approach to building products
  • Strives to maintain a world-class organization
  • Loves technology
  • Gives back to the community
  • Proven ability to stay self-motivated, work hard, own problems from start to finish, and bring order from chaos
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or as part of a broader team.
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, transparent, and fun


Preferred Experience

  • University degree in Computer Science, a related field of study, or equivalent experience
  • Experience in finance and/or energy, commodities, or equity trading
  • Experience with enterprise-grade software and highly secure, multi-tenant SaaS solutions
  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes
  • Experience with real-time, data-streaming technologies such as Kafka
  • Experience with Ember


Additional Information

  • Know that your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • Own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart, creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them and be transparent!
  • Be recognized as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Senior Accountant
description:
We are supporting a fast-growing technology company in the logistics space in the search for a highly skilled Senior Accounting Professional to join their finance team.


This role will play a key part in strengthening financial processes, ensuring IFRS/GAAP compliance, and driving data-driven insights across the business.


Key Responsibilities include:

• Leading journal entries across revenue, commissions, bonuses, intercompany and cost allocations

• Reviewing balance sheet reconciliations and monthly close activities

• Ensuring expense compliance and accurate financial reporting under IFRS

• Building and improving accounting policies, internal controls, and processes

• Supporting audits and complex accounting treatments

• Delivering monthly financial reporting and budget vs actual analysis

• Leveraging SQL, Python, Excel and AI to generate insights and improve efficiency


What we’re looking for:

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (CPA or equivalent required)

• 5+ years of relevant experience (preferably from public accounting or high-growth environments)

• Strong IFRS and U.S. GAAP knowledge

• Advanced Excel skills

• Experience with internal controls and SOX

• Fluent in English

• Comfortable working in fast-paced startup environments
