title: Business Development Representative
description:
Job Title: Outreach Specialist / Appointment Setter


Schedule: Full-time (40 hs/week).


Location: Fully remote, async-first.


About This Role:

Our client is looking for a dedicated and hungry Outreach Specialist to fuel their sales pipeline. This is a junior-to-mid-level role for a \"hunter\" who thrives on chasing leads and booking qualified meetings. You will be the engine of the sales process, responsible for the initial contact that turns cold prospects into warm opportunities.


We are looking for an Operator , not just a list-builder. You must be able to execute high-volume outreach across multiple channels (Cold Call, Email, LinkedIn) and diagnose what is working to optimize your results.


Responsibilities:

  • Meeting Generation: Your primary KPI is the number of qualified meetings booked per week and per month.
  • Omnichannel Outreach: Execute campaigns using Cold Calling, Email, and LinkedIn. You have the autonomy to use the channels that yield the best results.
  • Metric Tracking: Meticulously track your daily activity (volume of outreach) and your success rates (meetings booked).
  • Pipeline Management: Ensure no lead falls through the cracks; manage follow-ups religiously until a \"No\" or a \"Yes\" is achieved.
  • Feedback Loop: Provide feedback to the strategy team on lead quality and market response to improve targeting.

Requirements:

  • 2-3 years of experience (Minimum) in outreach, appointment setting, or SDR roles.
  • Proven Track Record: Must be able to demonstrate historical success rates (specifically: Average Meetings Generated per Month) from previous roles.
  • Tool Agnostic: Experience with any standard outreach tools (e.g., Apollo, Lemlist, Sales Navigator, RingCentral) is accepted.
  • High Availability: Willingness to work 40 hours/week.
  • Communication: Strong written and verbal English skills for cold calling and email copywriting.

  • 5-10+ years of professional software development experience

  • Experience in Business intelligence QuickSight developers, ETL process, and data extraction

  • Provides technical mentorship and work task direction to a team of developers; able to fill the Technical Owner role on an agile sprint team, holding people accountable for task delivery
  • Works with product management to groom and select Features for their area to be included in upcoming releases
  • Comfortable working within a fast-paced environment
  • Self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Knowledge of authentication systems (OAuth/OICS, OWASP security best practices including rate limiting and data encryption
  • Familiarity with AWS services, monitoring tools, and DevOps practices with the ability to troubleshoot complex production issues and implement effective solutions
  • Experience with DMS and CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Cox/VinSolutions, DealerSocket, DealerAccess), and VIN providers (e.g., DataOne, Polk, VinPower)
  • Familiarity with Google Analytics (GA4), Tag Manager (GTM), or Tag Assistant (GTA)

title: Fechador
description:
APENAS APLIQUE SE VOCÊ TEM EXPERIÊNCIA COM VENDAS HIGH TICKET E HISTÓRICO DE METAS BATIDAS


Sobre a HarmonizaPRO: Somos a maior aceleradora comercial para clinicas de harmonização facial do Brasil! Impactamos mais de 400 clinicas ao longo de 5 anos. Nosso papel é aumentar demanda, ticket médio e implementar um departamento comercial terceirizado para nós na clínica. Dessa forma conseguimos garantir o paciente sentado na cadeira da nossa cliente.


Se você tem experiência com vendas e busca um lugar de destaque em uma empresa em ascenção, essa vaga é para você. A HarmonizaPRO tem 48 colaboradores, investimos 150k+ em anúncios por mês e temos uma meta agressiva para esse ano. Temos uma CIA com pessoas idôneas e ambiciosas, todos aqui querem botar mais dinheiro no bolso e procuramos pessoas com o mesmo perfil cultural.


Ponto de extrema importância: mais do que um bom vendedor, estamos buscando um(a) excelente consultor(a). Aquela pessoa que conhece sobre negócios e ditará o melhor programa/produto para o cliente é quem buscamos. Se você pensa em apenas fazer um \"bico\" aqui, pegar algumas calls e tratar como um hobbie, pode passar para frente, não queremos você.

Queremos pessoas comprometidas, que tenham empatia com o sonho dos demais colaboradores e dos clientes para mantermos um ambiente de desenvolvimento contínuo.

Respiramos e vibramos a cada venda, mas o destaque sempre será nas vendas em que proporcionamos aos nossos clientes, essas vibramos ainda mais!

A HarmonizaPRO é uma ferramenta de transformação de vidas, e ela pode mudar a sua também.


  • Responsabilidades:
  • Conduzir reuniões de vendas consultivas (média 4-6 calls/dia)
  • Fechar contratos de R$12k a R$60k
  • Gerir seu pipeline no Pipedrive com disciplina
  • Nutrir leads com follow-ups estratégicos
  • Participar das rotinas do time (daily, weekly, 1:1)


  • Requisitos:
  • Experiência comprovada como vendedor (com resultados para mostrar)
  • Comunicação consultiva
  • Disciplina de processo e CRM
  • Proatividade e capacidade de resolver problemas sem precisar de babá
  • Ambição real de ganhar dinheiro
  • Conversão acima de 20%


  • Remuneração:
  • R$5.000,00 fixo inicial.
  • Comissão de 3% sobre o valor recebido, podendo chegar a 5% com progressão de taxa de conversão de vendas (média salarial de 12k a 28k).
  • +Bônus por metas batidas.


  • Regime de contratação: PJ.
  • Modelo de trabalho: Remoto, mas temos sede presencial para trabalhar também
  • Horário: Integral.
  • Apesar do contrato ser PJ, prezamos pela sua exclusividade com nossa empresa.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Senior Software Engineer


Language: Portuguese & English

Position: Remote

Experience: Senior


Key Responsibilities

  • Design develop and implement scalable middleware APIs and backend services to support user management and other API services across our client using Java with Spring Boot and Golang capable of handling thousands of requests per second RPS;
  • Optimize and manage existing high performance systems and services on both AWS and GCP;
  • Integrate with services across the streaming platform to ensure seamless functionality;
  • Leverage GCP technologies such as PubSub, GKE and Cloud SQL to create robust scalable systems;
  • Maintain and support AWS technologies including EKS, ECS, Lambda, Elasticache, AuroraRDS and Step Functions during the transition period;
  • Promote coding excellence and enforce best practices for building scalable high through put systems;
  • Actively participate in the design and architecture phases of new features and services ensuring scalability and performance;
  • Mentor junior team members providing guidance on building scalable middleware APIs and backend services;
  • Contribute to technical strategy and roadmaps for both AWS and GCP environments;
  • Collaborate with cross functional agile teams of software engineers, data engineers, ML experts and others to deliver new product features.


Mandatory Knowledge

  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science or related field or equivalent work experience;
  • 10 years of experience in software development;
  • Proficiency in Java with Spring Boot for developing scalable backend services;
  • Experience with Golang and familiarity with cloud technologies eg EKS, ECS, Lambda Elasticache, AuroraRDS, SQS, SNS, Step Functions;
  • Hands on experience with GCP technologies including PubSub, Kubernetes, MySQL and Spanner;
  • Strong technical communication skills to articulate complex solutions;
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively in a global cross functional environment with internal stakeholders and customers.



Does this sounds like something you'd like to do?

Apply and attach your resume in English and we'll take it from here. Excited to meet you!

title: Java Fullstack Developer (Angular)
description:
About You

You are a software engineer who enjoys building robust, scalable, and well-structured applications. You’re motivated by clean architecture, modern technologies, and meaningful collaboration across backend and frontend layers. You’re looking for a place where you can grow professionally, influence technical decisions, and contribute to high-impact products used by real customers.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of professional experience developing backend solutions using Java (21+) and Spring Boot.
  • Strong experience building and maintaining monolithic backend applications following clean architecture principles.
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and in-memory data stores such as Redis.
  • Proven experience working with AWS services, including S3, ECS, CloudWatch, and Bedrock.
  • Experience using MyBatis as an ORM and Liquibase for database versioning and migrations.
  • 2+ years of professional experience with Angular (v19 or similar), with strong usage of RxJS and Observables.
  • Familiarity with frontend monolith architectures and modern client-side frameworks.
  • Advanced knowledge of Git and version control best practices.
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Participate in collaborative concept definition, architectural refinement, and software design across backend and frontend layers.
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable monolithic applications using Java 21 and Spring Boot.
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and integrate them with Angular frontend applications using RxJS and Observables.
  • Implement and manage data persistence using PostgreSQL, MyBatis, Liquibase, and Redis.
  • Work with AWS infrastructure services (S3, ECS, CloudWatch, Bedrock) to support application deployment, monitoring, and observability.
  • Follow Agile practices, working independently while collaborating closely with a cross-functional team.
  • Maintain high-quality technical documentation throughout the SDLC.


Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with: Java 21, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Redis, Monolithic architecture design and development, AWS (S3, ECS, CloudWatch), Angular (v19 or similar), RxJS / Observables, MyBatis and Liquibase.
  • Strong communication skills in English and Spanish.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Customer Onboarding Analyst
description:
We’re expanding our Customer Success team and hiring a high-performing Onboarding Specialist. You will own the customers' first 30 - 45 days, set the tone for the relationship, build confidence and ensure customers are ready quickly and correctly. This role defines the customer’s first impression of Smarter Contact and has clear growth potential within a fast-scaling SaaS company. This is a direct-hire role.


About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the U.S., powering tens of millions of text and voice conversations every month, helping real estate professionals close more deals.



What You’ll Own:

  • Lead and follow up on all 1-1 or group onboarding sessions via phone, video, text, and email using our own tech stack
  • Complete all daily CRM tasks (to-dos, emails, texts, calls, etc.)
  • Guide customers through initial setup, configuration, and first live campaigns
  • Establish clear expectations for SMS performance, compliance, and best practices
  • Reinforce Smarter Contact’s value proposition, positioning, and differentiators
  • Ensure customers reach defined activation milestones within the onboarding window
  • Proactively identify confusion, friction, or risk during onboarding-escalate and resolve
  • Document onboarding outcomes, next steps, and handoff notes clearly in CRM
  • Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience to ensure a clean transition post onboarding
  • Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 AM - 7 pm Eastern Standard Time or later, Monday to Friday

description:
Redfaire is a fast-growing, international technology company headquartered in Limerick, Ireland. Redfaire implements, optimises and supports users of Oracle ERP. Our goal is to transform the way our clients do business by developing and implementing IT solutions that create value, drive innovation, and reduce overall costs.


We are problem solvers and trusted advisors and are committed to developing long-term, mutually beneficial partnerships with our customers. Our customers work in many industries and range from, large-scale multinationals to ambitious SMBs. What our customers have in common is the strategic use of technology to build a sustainable competitive advantage.


Role Description:

Working as part of the Redfaire Technical Services team, this role will provide primary infrastructure support, ensuring customer systems (hosted in cloud or on-premise) are protected and healthy.

In addition to providing on-going administration and housekeeping, the role also requires competence in networking, virtualisation and cloud technology, including but not limited to provisioning new server infrastructure and allocating compute resources, namely disk, memory and CPU.


The candidate should have excellent verbal & written communication skills in English & proven analytical and problem-solving skills in a complex technical environment. The candidate will also need the ability to work with a mix of remote and office-based resources. This role will support US business hours.


All resumes must be submitted in English to be considered.


Responsibilities:

  • Run and maintain infrastructure instances within cloud or on-premise.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues (Cloud, OS, network).
  • Keep Customer up to date on the progress via ticketing systems.
  • Participate in on-call rota. Work with the Delivery Team to;
  • Onboard new customers
  • Implement service improvement plans
  • Liaise with consultants and other internal departments including the CNC, database, functional support and development teams.Develop Industry Knowledge: keeping the team abreast of current trends and technologies and sourcing training where necessary.
  • Ensure customer systems are protected by;
  • Applying recommended security patches
  • Ensuring Backup and Recovery scripts are in place and working
  • Forecast logical and physical space and processing demands.
  • Ensure ISO27001 / GDPR compliance.


Qualifications, Experience & Skills:

  • Relevant 3rd level qualification or equivalent.
  • At least 5 years’ experience of working as a senior OS/network administration role in multi-customer environment.
  • 2+ years of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), including Oracle Observability & Management experience essential.
  • Expert Linux knowledge, including strong Linux troubleshooting skills essential.
  • Expert Windows knowledge.
  • Very good understanding of network concepts.
  • Systematic approach to problem resolution.
  • Ability to work independently under one’s own initiative whilst being part of a team.
  • Ability to work under pressure, take leadership & to prioritize workloads.
  • Recognize the importance of customer service and strive to deliver high standards.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft products such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook.

title: JDE CNC Consultant
description:
About Us:

Redfaire is a growing, international technology company headquartered in Limerick, Ireland. Redfaire helps global organisations modernise their JD Edwards environments, migrate to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and unlock value through automation, analytics, and innovation.

Innovation is at the heart of everything at Redfaire, we provide guidance and expertise to our customers in Oracle Cloud, Integrations, AI and Machine Learning.

Headquartered in Limerick, Ireland, we also have offices in UK and USA and a direct presence in other international locations. As a founding partner of Redfaire International, a global network of top-tier JD Edwards consultancies, we’re able to deliver even broader, more impactful solutions to our clients worldwide.


About the Role:

We are currently recruiting a CNC Consultant to join our busy Technical Services Team. The CNC Consultant is responsible for the installation and configuration of JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, including environment setup, user access, security, distributed processing, and version control, as well as testing CNC configurations and controlling software deployment throughout the organisation.

The candidate should have excellent verbal & written communication skills in English & proven analytical and problem-solving skills. The candidate will also need the ability to work in a remote team environment.

Due to the requirement to support our clients in specific time zones, we are seeking appointment of candidates within the LatAm Region.


Responsibilities:

The CNC Consultant role is extremely broad, and responsibilities include (but are not limited to);

  • Oracle ERP (JD Edwards) System Administration, which includes Server and Application Administration, ERP Security Management at user and role level.
  • Planning and installation of business application patches also called electronic software updates or ESUs as well as underlying foundational code or programs called tools releases or service packs
  • Building and deploying changes to the business applications via package management.
  • Management of various business environments & path codes like development, user acceptance testing (UAT) and production, making sure each environment has relevant privileges for users to work with objects in OMW along with required OCM Mapping and Datasources.
  • Ability to Setup and Troubleshoot Printer configuration within JDE, Transform and Print Server
  • Server Manager (the Tools Release 9.1 and above) system management console advance skills.
  • Performance tuning of applications and web servers using Server Manager to analyze kernel processes and obtain log files for detailed analysis.
  • Basic system auditing and performance tuning tasks.
  • Development of software tools and processes to automate repetitive CNC tasks
  • Refreshing and optimization of the underlying database, working with database administrators
  • Experience/expertise with SQL databases such as Oracle, SQL Server with regards to EnterpriseOne
  • Adherence to Redfaire and client Data Protection policies.


Qualifications & Skills:


  • Technical Experience: Minimum 6-7 Years of JDE CNC experience.
  • Expertise in the technical architecture for EnterpriseOne (e.g. Citrix servers, WebLogic servers, WebSphere servers, deployment server, batch/enterprise servers, BSSV servers, mobile apps/AIS servers plus multiple OS's including Windows, Unix/Linux & AS400 can be advantageous)
  • Experience in adding custom environments and custom datasource setups
  • Knowledge of CNC mapping configuration changes using Object Configuration Manager (OCM)
  • Expertise in multiple JDE system software configurations (multi-foundation), Tools Release Updates
  • Relevant 3rd level qualification or equivalent.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal & written.
  • Technical competence with proven analytical skills.
  • Problem solving and trouble shooting skills (which requires a wide range of skills beyond JDE CNC skills such as networking, storage, database, operating system, and virtual infrastructures and the ability to work with people who are experts in these areas)
  • Systematic approach to problem resolution.
  • Ability to work independently under one’s own initiative whilst being part of a global team.
  • Proven ability to be adaptable and to respond to constantly changing demands.
  • Ability to work under pressure & to prioritize.
  • Recognise the importance of customer service and strive to deliver high standards.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft products such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook.


What we offer:

  • Career growth within an expanding global award-winning Oracle Partner recognised for excellence.
  • Supportive team culture with ongoing training and mentorship.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunity to engage in flexible working arrangements, including remote options, to help you maintain a healthy work-life balance.

Redfaire is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to building an integrative culture where everyone feels welcomed and supported. Our inclusive workplace provides an environment that will support your development no matter your gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

title: Sr. DevOps Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Sr. DevOps Engineer to work for our client. The ideal candidate aligns with the responsibilities and qualifications outlined below.


About the Role

Our client is seeking a DevOps Engineer to support CI/CD pipelines, improve automation, and ensure the reliability of production systems. You’ll work closely with development and infrastructure teams to streamline deployments, enhance performance, and maintain secure, scalable environments.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and improve build/deployment pipelines.
  • Administer Azure DevOps (permissions, branching, policies).
  • Support deployments using tools like Octopus Deploy.
  • Troubleshoot build and deployment issues.
  • Monitor production environments and coordinate upgrades.
  • Implement automation to reduce technical debt and improve CI/CD efficiency.
  • Assist with infrastructure management using Chef, Terraform, or similar tools.
  • Maintain documentation and communicate project status to stakeholders.


Qualifications

  • Microsoft system administration experience.
  • Active Directory, Windows Server, and IIS knowledge.
  • Familiarity with .NET environments and Git.
  • PowerShell scripting skills.
  • Linux administration experience.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Chef/Terraform).
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.
  • Experience in agile development environments.


What Our Client Offers

  • 100% remote work in Brazil.
  • Modern DevOps tools and technologies.
  • Collaborative, growth-focused engineering culture.

title: Consulting Partner
description:
ERA Group, a global leader in cost management and business optimisation, is looking for an entrepreneurial Partner to join our international network of consultants.

This is not a traditional consultancy role; it’s a chance to run your own practice within a global brand, with the freedom to shape your market, build your team, and grow your client base while backed by ERA’s proven methodologies, tools, and worldwide community.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead cost optimisation, procurement, and performance improvement programmes across industries
  • Build and grow your client portfolio through business development and long-term partnerships
  • Take ownership of your practice’s strategic direction, go-to-market approach, and team leadership
  • Work directly with C-level clients to deliver measurable savings and transformation


What You Bring

  • Extensive consulting or senior leadership experience in cost management, procurement, or performance improvement
  • A strong track record of client acquisition and project delivery
  • Deep expertise in one or more industries such as Pharma/Life Sciences, Energy/Utilities, Manufacturing, Consumer, or Logistics
  • Confidence in engaging with CxO-level stakeholders and leveraging your professional network
  • An entrepreneurial mindset with the ambition to grow a successful consulting practice



This is the ideal next step if you’re seeking less bureaucracy, more independence, and the chance to build something of your own within a global consultancy platform.


By applying, you agree to the use of your personal data for recruitment and related communications, in accordance with the UK GDPR.

title: Analytics Engineer (Pleno)
description:
Na Conquest One, somos mais do que uma consultoria tecnológica: somos uma equipe movida pela paixão por inovação e pelo impacto positivo que geramos nos nossos clientes e colaboradores. 28 anos de história e 15x eleita uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar em tecnologia no Brasil (GPTW). Desde 2021, também estamos presentes em Portugal!


Estamos em busca de um Analytics Engineer (Pleno), confira as informações da vaga:


Descrição da Vaga

Atuar no desenvolvimento e otimização de pipelines de dados e soluções analíticas escaláveis , transformando dados brutos em insights estratégicos para o negócio . Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com equipes multifuncionais para garantir qualidade, acessibilidade e usabilidade dos dados , promovendo uma cultura data-driven na organização.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Realizar modelagem de dados para atender às necessidades específicas dos times de negócio.
  • Atuar em parceria com stakeholders para compreender demandas e desenvolver produtos de dados (pipelines, indicadores e dashboards) com foco no usuário final.
  • Desenvolver datasets que servirão como fonte única da verdade da empresa , seguindo a arquitetura Medallion (Gold/Diamond) .
  • Garantir a qualidade, integridade e consistência dos dados em múltiplas fontes e plataformas, propondo e implementando soluções automatizadas.
  • Implementar melhorias em processos internos por meio da disponibilização de dados e datasets escaláveis .
  • Atuar como defensor do valor de negócio dos dados , oferecendo orientação técnica e soluções para desafios estratégicos.
  • Construir, manter e evoluir pipelines analíticos com a abordagem de dados como produto , desde o dado bruto até o dado ouro, pronto para consumo por algoritmos e réguas de comunicação.
  • Monitorar a saúde, qualidade e performance da infraestrutura analítica , realizando otimizações contínuas.
  • Desenvolver análises, visualizações, gráficos e dashboards a partir da infraestrutura de dados implementada.
  • Colaborar com engenheiros de dados e de infraestrutura em projetos técnicos e evolutivos.


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Sólida experiência na escrita de queries em SQL, Python e/ou R , com foco em performance e escalabilidade .
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização e análise de dados , como Looker, Power BI ou similares.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e analíticos , como BigQuery e Redshift .


Interessou?

Envie seu currículo e venha fazer parte de um time que valoriza técnica, protagonismo e impacto real nas soluções!

title: Senior NodeJS Developer
description:
Senior Node.js Developer

Location: Brazil (preferred)

Contract / Contract-to-Hire | Immediate Start

We’re looking for a Senior Node.js Developer to join a fast-growing engineering team working on regulated financial platforms across LATAM.


This is an urgent, high-impact hire. You’ll be joining at a critical stage, helping to deliver key product milestones and scale secure, high-availability systems in a regulated environment.

If you enjoy ownership, autonomy, and building systems that genuinely matter - this role is for you.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Building and scaling backend services using Node.js
  • Deploying and managing applications in Kubernetes
  • Working with MongoDB in production environments
  • Contributing to cloud infrastructure (Azure or AWS)
  • Identifying technical risks and proactively solving them
  • Collaborating closely with product and engineering stakeholders


What We’re Looking For

  • 5–8+ years of backend development experience
  • Strong commercial experience with Node.js (essential)
  • Experience with Kubernetes and containerised environments
  • Solid knowledge of MongoDB
  • Experience with Azure or AWS (nice to have)
  • Comfortable working in regulated or high-availability environments


More importantly, we’re looking for someone who:

  • Takes ownership
  • Communicates clearly
  • Thinks ahead and manages risk
  • Works independently
  • Thrives in fast-paced teams


Experience in Financial Services, Open Finance, or Banking is a plus.

title: Analista de Automação - CAWA (Remoto)
description:
Olá!

A Aggrandize nasceu em 2015 com a missão de engrandecer pessoas e negócios . Guiados por valores como adaptabilidade, colaboração, foco no cliente e visão de dono, oferecemos soluções que transformam desafios em oportunidades.


Somos especialistas em Platform Engineering , Data Analytics , Modern Applications e Cybersecurity , sempre com o compromisso de impulsionar o crescimento e a inovação de nossos parceiros.


Nosso trabalho é mais do que tecnologia; é sobre potencializar resultados. Increase the power of your business .


Agora que você conhece a cultura Aggrandize, saiba mais sobre a oportunidade:


Estamos em busca de um Analista de Automação de Workload especializado em CA Workload Automation (CAWA) com experiência em automação de processos e habilidades técnicas para gerenciar e otimizar workloads através da plataforma CAWA.


❇️ O seu papel no time:

  • Gerenciamento de Workloads: Planejar, implementar e monitorar processos automatizados utilizando CAWA;
  • Análise de Performance: Executar análises contínuas para identificar oportunidades de melhoria na automação de tarefas;
  • Suporte Técnico: Fornecer suporte técnico e orientação para a equipe em relação a problemas relacionados ao CAWA;
  • Colaboração Interdepartamental: Trabalhar em conjunto com outras equipes para garantir a integração eficaz de sistemas e processos;
  • Documentação: Criar e manter documentação técnica sobre processos e procedimentos de automação.


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Hard Skills:

  • Formação: Graduação em Tecnologia da Informação, Ciência da Computação ou área relacionada;
  • Experiência: Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência com CA Workload Automation, com domínio nas funcionalidades da ferramenta;
  • Habilidades Técnicas: Conhecimento em scripting (e.g., Python, Bash) e experiência com bancos de dados;
  • Capacidade Analítica: Habilidade para analisar problemas complexos e propor soluções eficazes.


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Soft Skills:

  • Adaptabilidade;
  • Colaboração;
  • Visão de Dono;
  • Foco no Cliente.

title: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?


Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:


  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?


No papel de Engenheiro de Dados você atuará em um time multidisciplinar, contribuindo com o entendimento de problemas do negócio e soluções de dados para ajudar a solucionar esses problemas. Também será responsável pelo desenvolvimento de pipelines de ETL/ELT em ambientes cloud, utilizando ferramentas de orquestração e linguagens de programação, tais como Python e SQL. Além dessas atividades, o papel de data engineer também pode contribuir com entendimento de melhorias diversas que podem ser aplicadas em um projeto de dados, tais como algoritmos de ML, em parceria com o data scientist, e melhorias em performance e custos.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:


  • Linguagem de Programação (Python, PySpark);
  • Airflow - Criação de ambiente e desenvolvimento de data pipelines;
  • Bancos relacionais, não relacionais e de data warehouse: BigQuery, MongoDB, SQL Server, Oracle, Hive, Hadoop;
  • Desenvolvimento de queries em ANSI SQL;
  • Serviços Cloud GCP, AWS e Azure relacionados à área de engenharia de dados;
  • Consumo de API Rest e SOAP;
  • ETL e ELT;
  • Conhecimento e aplicação prática em Airflow.


Será um diferencial se você tiver também:


  • Conhecimento e aplicação prática Machine Learning e AI.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?


  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.

title: ServiceNow Developer with Strategic Portfolio Management(SPM) & ITSM
description:
Title: ServiceNow Developer with Strategic Portfolio Management(SPM) & ITSM

Location: 100% Remote

Job Type: Contract

Job Specific Responsibilities:

● Have the ability to assist requesters in refining business requirement details to ensure the customers will be receiving functionality requested.

● Gain knowledge of our overall ServiceNow implementation to understand and identify cross platform impacts of changes or enhancements being requested.

● Design, develop, and implement SPM solutions including workflows, catalog items, workspaces, and integrations to meet complex business requirements

● Configure and customize the ServiceNow platform using javascript and ServiceNow APIs to extend capabilities and enhance user experience

title: Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.


Data Cloud Consultant

Skills:

It is desirable that the candidate has a Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant certification, and should have experience in implementing and consulting on enterprise data platforms in a customer-facing role, including design, configuration, and solution architecture.


Recommendation:

Experience in implementing and working with strategy and data modeling, including building multiple solutions on Salesforce clouds.

- Have experience in development, strategy, business analysis, pre-sales solutions, or architecture.


Job Description:

Responsible for conducting customer discussions around requirements and technical drawing.

Development of software programs by technical specifications following programming standards and procedures, performing unit tests, performing program modifications and responding to problems by diagnosing and correcting logic and coding errors.

Ensure that secure coding and UI standards and best practices are applied during development.

Provide inputs and contribute to the improvement and maintenance of applications and programs.

Leading efforts to configure, analyze, design, develop, and maintain program code and applications.

Execution of detailed and complex unit tests and secure code testing and troubleshooting.

Conducting and supporting the source code management process.

Contributing to integration, systems and performance testing and code tuning.

Participation in secure code peer reviews.

Definition and promotion of opportunities for the reuse of code, configurations, procedures and techniques.


Requirements:

Degrees in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field are preferred.

Fluency in English to conduct technical meetings with offshore team, support teams and customers outside Brazil.

Experience with Data Architecture

Experience in writing SQL queries and data modeling, as well as governance and architecture performance practice and guidelines

Proficient in migrating data from traditional applications to Salesforce using the Import Wizard and Data Loader utility

Experienced in handling multi-country deployments and managing multiple instances of Salesforce.com

Experience with setting up and customizing managed Field Service packages is a plus.

Solution Modeling - Creates, designs, and formulates models, diagrams, and documentation using IT processes, standards, tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Data Modeling - Creates, writes, and tests data models, test scripts, and build scripts using IT processes, patterns, and tools, version control, and automation

Performance tuning - Conceptualizes, analyzes, and resolves application, database, and hardware issues using IT processes, standards, and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Solution Validation Testing - Validates a configuration item or solution change using the IT Operating Model (ITOM), including SDLC standards, tools, and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.

Customer Focus - Building strong customer relationships and providing customer-centric solutions.

Manages complexity – Understanding complex, high-quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to solve problems effectively.

Global perspective – Take a broad view when addressing issues, using a global lens.

Action-oriented – Taking on new opportunities and difficult challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Optimizes work processes – Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.


Skills:

Knowledge of service-oriented design (SOA) principles.

Excellent oral, presentation and written communication skills.

Good interpersonal skills.

Extensive knowledge of Salesforce technology and specifically the data cloud and its features and terminologies;

Experience in positioning and implementing Salesforce Data Cloud.

Salesforce Data Cloud certifications will be a plus for this role.

Proven experience in implementation and consulting of Salesforce Data Cloud environments.


At HCLTech, we don’t just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Join a global team where your work drives innovation, your ideas matter, and your growth is supported every step of the way.


Why Choose HCLTech?

  • Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint
  • Collaborate with diverse teams across borders
  • Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration
  • Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion

title: Analista de Suporte Pleno – SRE/Cloud
description:
Sua próxima oportunidade está a caminho!


A VILT é uma empresa de TI, onde valorizamos nosso pessoal, promovemos o trabalho em equipe e, é claro, o bom humor.


Acreditamos que a diversidade e a inclusão fortalecem o nosso time. Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas, e profissionais com deficiência (PCDs) são incentivados a se candidatar.

Dê uma olhada nesta oportunidade de emprego e veja se você é o próximo VILTian! (se você conhece alguém, não se esqueça de recomendá-lo)


Buscamos um(a) Analista de Suporte Pleno com foco em SRE e Cloud para atuar na sustentação, evolução e confiabilidade de ambientes críticos em nuvem. Essa pessoa terá papel ativo na estabilidade de sistemas produtivos, atuando desde o monitoramento e automação até a análise e resolução de incidentes, sempre em parceria com times de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura e segurança.


O que você irá fazer:

  • Atuar na sustentação e evolução de ambientes Cloud (AWS, Microsoft Azure e/ou Google Cloud Platform)
  • Administrar e dar suporte a clusters Kubernetes
  • Implementar e manter soluções de monitoramento, observabilidade e alertas
  • Analisar e resolver incidentes, realizando troubleshooting em ambientes produtivos
  • Apoiar na definição, acompanhamento e cumprimento de SLAs
  • Automatizar processos operacionais como deploys, rotinas, escalabilidade e correções
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura e segurança
  • Propor melhorias contínuas visando maior resiliência, performance e redução de incidentes
  • Atuar em regime de plantão conforme escala 24x7


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos atuando com suporte, SRE, Cloud ou áreas correlatas
  • Experiência prática com ambientes Cloud (AWS, Azure e/ou GCP)
  • Conhecimento sólido em Kubernetes e containers (Docker)
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (Grafana, Zabbix, Datadog, New Relic, Elastic, Dynatrace ou similares)
  • Conhecimento em sistemas Linux
  • Experiência com troubleshooting de aplicações e infraestrutura
  • Noções de redes, balanceamento de carga e alta disponibilidade
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em plantões em escala 24x7
  • Boa comunicação e facilidade para trabalhar em equipe e expor ideias


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em pipelines de CI/CD
  • Vivência com práticas e cultura DevOps
  • Certificações Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP)
  • Perfil analítico, proativo, com senso de dono e foco em melhoria contínua
  • Capacidade de lidar com incidentes e situações críticas de forma estruturada


Informações adicionais:

  • Modelo de contrato CLT


Se você estiver pronto para levar sua carreira de suporte SRE e Cloud para o próximo nível, adoraríamos conhecê-lo!

title: Clinical Statistical Programmer (SAS / CDISC)
description:
Job Title: Clinical Statistical Programmer (SAS / CDISC)

Location - Brazil


Role Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented Clinical Statistical Programmer to support clinical trial data standardization, analysis, and regulatory submissions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in CDISC standards (SDTM & ADaM), SAS programming, and generation of Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs), along with experience in quality control and submission readiness.

Key Responsibilities

· Transform raw clinical trial data into CDISC-compliant SDTM and ADaM datasets

· Develop, validate, and maintain Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs) for clinical study reports and regulatory submissions

· Write efficient, well-documented SAS programs for data cleaning, derivations, and reporting

· Develop reusable Python or R scripts for automation, validation, and reproducible reporting

· Perform programming QC and peer reviews to ensure accuracy and traceability

· Prepare and maintain programming specifications, mapping documents, and annotated


CRFs

· Troubleshoot complex data integration and derivation issues

· Support audits and regulatory inspections with reproducible code and documentation


Required Qualifications

· Strong experience with SAS programming

· Hands-on experience with CDISC standards (SDTM & ADaM)

· Experience generating TLFs for regulatory submissions

· Knowledge of clinical trial data structures and submission processes

· Familiarity with Python or R for automation (preferred)

· Strong attention to detail and documentation practices


Preferred

· Experience supporting FDA/EMA regulatory submissions

· Prior experience in a Pharma, Biotech, or CRO environment

title: Desenvolvedor Senior Full Stack
description:
Sobre o Colab

O Colab é uma empresa que conecta a população ao governo, dando mais voz ao cidadão e proporcionando uma gestão pública mais colaborativa . 

Operamos no modelo SaaS (Software as a Service), disponibilizando uma plataforma de gerenciamento de serviços omnichannel , ou seja, que centraliza todos os atendimentos ao cidadão, via aplicativo/website do colab e integrações (como WhatsApp).

O produto do Colab pode ser dividido em diversas frentes, porém nosso público prioritário são os gestores de prefeituras municipais. Para eles, somos um canal para melhorar o relacionamento com o munícipe e uma plataforma para disponibilizar os serviços da prefeitura na palma da mão do cidadão (via aplicativo), colhendo informações que servem como respaldo para as ações e planejamentos municipais e promovem a gestão transparente .

Aqui, a tecnologia escala nosso propósito. Somos movidos pela inovação tecnológica para gerar alto impacto positivo na sociedade, atuando como sinônimo de soluções simplificadas para a coisa pública.


Objetivo

Como Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack Sênior, você terá o desafio de arquitetar e desenvolver soluções que transformem a gestão pública. Você não apenas escreverá código, mas ajudará a \"resolver problemas complexos a partir de soluções criativas e sustentáveis\" e pensamento “AI first”.

Seu trabalho impactará diretamente a vida de outras pessoas, desenvolvendo produtos com afeto e método. Você atuará na modernização da nossa stack, integrando Inteligência Artificial para co-criar uma gestão pública fluida e eficiente.

Desafios e responsabilidades

  • Atuar em todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento de software (end-to-end) utilizando metodologia SCRUM, garantindo entregas ágeis e de valor.
  • Projetar e manter arquiteturas escaláveis em AWS, com forte uso de Serverless (Lambdas) e serviços gerenciados.
  • Liderar a implementação de funcionalidades baseadas em Inteligência Artificial Generativa, utilizando preferencialmente AWS Bedrock, para criar soluções preditivas e assistivas para o cidadão e o gestor público.
  • Desenvolver interfaces ricas e performáticas com React/Next.js e TypeScript, integradas a backends robustos em Node.js ou Python.
  • Gerenciar e otimizar consultas em bancos de dados relacionais (RDS Postgres) e não relacionais (MongoDB).
  • Ser uma referência técnica para o time. No Colab, trocamos informação de forma aberta e estendemos a mão para ajudar, pois nunca erramos sozinhos.
  • Garantir a qualidade do código através de Code Reviews, testes automatizados (com IA) e boas práticas de segurança, agindo sempre com ética e transparência.

Habilidades Técnicas Necessárias (Hard Skills)

  • Sólida experiência como Fullstack Developer em produtos digitais. Será considerado um diferencial ter atuado em GovTechs ou produtos SaaS.
  • Experiência comprovada com Python e Node.js.
  • Vivência prática com ambiente AWS (AWS Lambda Serverless, API Gateway, RDS).
  • Proficiência em SQL (SQL Server e PostgreSQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB).
  • Experiência em integração de LLMs e APIs de IA em produtos e prática com AWS Bedrock.
  • Será considerado um diferencial experiência com Amazon Q Developer, KIRO ou CodeRabbit.
  • Domínio avançado de Javascript/TypeScript, React.js e Next.js.
  • Experiência prévia trabalhando com rituais ágeis (Scrum/Kanban). Conhecimento em DevOps (CircleCI).


DNA e Cultura (Soft Skills)

Para dar match com o Colab, esperamos que você:

  • Mindset \"AI-first\": Acreditamos que tudo que precisa ser feito, pode ser ajudado por uma IA; principalmente na codificação e testes.
  • Tenha coragem para ser vulnerável: Aceitamos que erramos e amamos feedbacks construtivos. Estamos em constante processo de aprendizagem.
  • Seja Colaborativo(a): O valor está no time. Trabalhamos juntos para superar obstáculos e somos comprometidos com o sucesso de todos.
  • Seja Proativo(a): Não esperamos alguém pedir para resolver um problema.
  • Tenha Foco no Cliente: Temos compromisso com a transformação do cliente e construímos soluções co-criadas. O cliente está no centro.
  • Valorize a Diversidade: Somos comprometidos com a inclusão e equidade, nutrindo diferentes olhares para construir soluções.

title: TechOps Specialist (HL7 Integration)
description:
TechOps (HL7 Integration)


*English Resume Only

Role Type: Full-Time Contract

Hours: Must be willing to work US EST Hours

Location: Brazil

Reporting To: VP of Operations


About The Methodical Group


The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as ExactTalent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.


About the Opportunity


Our client, a growing healthcare SaaS organization, is seeking a Technical Operations Specialist to support post-sales technical implementations and system integrations.

This role is responsible for configuring and deploying HL7 interfaces within client environments, ensuring secure and accurate data connectivity between the SaaS platform and customer systems. The ideal candidate understands healthcare data workflows, integration standards, and how to work cross-functionally with client IT teams to enable seamless interoperability.

This is a post-sales, client-facing technical role that blends implementation, troubleshooting, and systems integration.


Ideal Candidate Profile


  • 3–6+ years of experience in healthcare IT, technical operations, or systems integration
  • Direct experience working with HL7 interfaces (v2.x preferred)
  • Experience connecting SaaS platforms to EHR or clinical systems
  • Strong understanding of healthcare data structures and workflows
  • Experience working with APIs, endpoints, or secure data transmission protocols
  • Ability to troubleshoot integration issues independently
  • Strong communication skills when working with client IT teams


Preferred Experience


  • Experience within a healthcare SaaS organization
  • Familiarity with EHR systems
  • Experience with interface engines
  • Knowledge of HIPAA-compliant data handling practices


Key Responsibilities


Post-Sales Implementation Support

  • Lead technical onboarding activities following customer contract execution
  • Configure and deploy HL7 interfaces within client instances
  • Coordinate with client IT and EHR teams to establish secure data connections
  • Ensure accurate mapping of inbound and outbound data fields

HL7 & Data Integration

  • Build, configure, and validate HL7 message interfaces
  • Support integration between the SaaS platform and client EHR or clinical systems
  • Troubleshoot data transmission errors and interface failures
  • Validate endpoint connectivity and message formatting

Client Collaboration

  • Serve as technical point of contact during implementation
  • Communicate integration requirements clearly to client technical stakeholders
  • Assist in diagnosing and resolving integration-related issues
  • Support go-live and stabilization efforts

System & Workflow Optimization

  • Monitor integration performance and data accuracy
  • Improve documentation around interface setup and troubleshooting
  • Contribute to process improvements within the technical operations function

title: Engenheiro de Exchange
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.



O que buscamos?

  • Especialista em Microsoft Exchange (On-Premises & Online) com foco em Segurança.


Principais responsabilidades técnicas:

  • Migração de Exchange On-Premises para Microsoft Exchange Online
  • Projetos e upgrades de Microsoft Exchange Server (2010, 2013, 2016, 2019)
  • Configuração híbrida, fluxo de e-mail (SMTP), DAG, alta disponibilidade e disaster recovery
  • Configuração de MX apontando para EOP ou gateways de terceiros
  • Scripting avançado em PowerShell
  • Health checks, troubleshooting avançado e recomendações de boas práticas


Infraestrutura & Identidade:

  • Arquitetura e administração de Active Directory (2008/2016)
  • Experiência sólida em ambientes on-premises
  • Cluster de Failover
  • Experiência comprovada em múltiplos projetos (mín. 5 anos em arquitetura, implantação e suporte)


Segurança e Compliance (diferencial importante):

  • Microsoft Defender for Office 365 (políticas de higiene de e-mail, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, Threat Explorer, Quarantine, Advanced Hunting)
  • Microsoft Purview (retenção, rótulos de sensibilidade, DLP, eDiscovery; diferenciais: Insider Risk, Information Barriers e Communication Compliance)



CLT FULL + Benefícios

Contrato híbrido para **eventuais** viagens e visitas a cliente.


O que oferecemos?


· Contratação CLT;

· Vale Refeição;

· Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;

· Auxílio creche;

· Convênio com Farmácia;

· Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;

· Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;

· Seguro de Vida.



“O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).”

title: Application Developer (Maintenance - JAVA/MySQL)
description:
We are looking for an Application Developer with strong experience in Java and My to support and enhance our client's application system, on the transportation product line.

The ideal candidate will be highly adept at working in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment with a small team, have proven on-time delivery experience, strong problem-solving abilities as well as aptitude to learn new technologies and concepts quickly, and be trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent.

Our industry-leading client provides cloud-based business automation software for over 2000 independent upstream and midstream oil & gas companies in North America. The companys solutions manage land, production, accounting, and transportation for E&P operators, crude oil purchasers, transporters, haulers, investors, and accounting firms. Their customers benefit through the automation of the most complex business processes to reduce operating costs, save time, and increase profitability via reporting, analytics, and decision support systems that were once exclusive to the major integrated oil companies.


Responsibilities

  • Portal & Server Management: Troubleshoot portal server ers, monitor AWS logs, and ensure report delivery.
  • ETL & Data Operations: Manage ETL file uploads, monitor ongoing/completed loads, and resolve missing data issues.
  • Reporting (JasperReports): Maintain and enhance custom reports, add/remove columns and filters, manage run tickets, and troubleshoot disappearing reports.
  • Database Management (My): Perform schema updates, optimize queries, and ensure data integrity for reporting and ETL processes.
  • Integrations: Support Samsara, Geotab, and Motive integrations and data imports.
  • Environment Management: Handle migrations between Alpha, Beta, and Production environments.
  • Bulk Updates: Execute mass-scale changes (Tank ID, Lease Name, Account, Terminal details) and perform data cleanup.


Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 3+ years of experience using Java and My
  • Solid understanding of AWS logs and backend troubleshooting, preferably using Cloud watch
  • Comfortable working in CI/CD environments with Agile development practices
  • Understanding of ETL & Data Management for file uploads and load monitoring
  • Detail-oriented and highly organized with a proactive mindset
  • Able to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Experience with JasperReports
  • Prior experience using React.js


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: ServiceNow Technical Architect
description:
ServiceNow Technical Architect


Start Date: ASAP

End Date: Aug 28, 2026

100% remote

English and Portuguese are required

Candidates from LATAM


We are seeking a true Technical Architect (not a developer/consultant) to lead and drive developers in a CSM workstream. This role is the technical leader responsible for designing, building, and maintaining ServiceNow’s unified customer engagement platform (NOW Engage), serving Expert Services and Partner consultants globally.


The Technical Architect translates business requirements into scalable, maintainable solutions, ensures platform integrity and performance, and provides hands‑on technical leadership across the full delivery lifecycle.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design scalable ServiceNow solutions aligned with best practices.
  • Lead architecture for multi‑tenant NOW Engage, ensuring security, data isolation, and performance.
  • Architect integrations with external systems (REST APIs, Integration Hub, AI/GenAI features).
  • Guide scrum teams, oversee code reviews, and enforce technical standards.
  • Collaborate with Business Analysts, executives, and cross‑functional teams to align business and technical goals.
  • Ensure compliance with enterprise standards, security, and regulatory requirements (GDPR, CCPA).
  • Drive continuous improvement through monitoring, automation, CI/CD, and documentation.


Requirements:

  • 6–10+ years of ServiceNow experience (development, administration, architecture).
  • Deep knowledge of ServiceNow products (CSM, SPM, ITSM, ITOM).
  • Expertise in custom app development, advanced data models, workflows, and API integrations.
  • Strong coding skills (JavaScript, REST/SOAP APIs, Integration Hub, UI Builder).
  • Experience with multi‑tenant architecture, scalability, and performance optimization.
  • Ability to clearly communicate technical concepts to non‑technical stakeholders.


Preferred

  • ServiceNow CTA, CIS, or CAD certifications.
  • Experience with AI/GenAI integrations and Agile/SAFe methodologies.
  • Leadership of scrum teams and collaboration with external vendors.
  • Knowledge of cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps.


Key Attributes

  • Architectural thinking and problem‑solving.
  • Strong technical leadership and quality focus.
  • Executive presence with excellent communication skills.
  • Collaborative and adaptable in dynamic environments.
  • Willingness to travel up to 25% annually.

title: Compliance Officer
description:
Compliance Officer


TG Lab is a technology company powering some of the biggest winners in sports betting and online casino products. We provide player account management and engagement technology to industry leaders such as Stake.com, Belgium National Lottery, Betsson Group , and many others. Our innovative yet practical solutions fuel world-class real-money wagering technology that supports over 1 million players. Our iGaming software is designed for distribution to casino and sportsbook operators across the EU, USA , and Asia.


We are looking for a meticulous and proactive Compliance Officer to ensure our operations and business activities adhere to all legal, technical and regulatory requirements, as well as internal policies. As a key member of the compliance team, you will work across departments to promote a strong compliance culture and help safeguard the company’s integrity and reputation.


Responsibilities:


  • Monitor and ensure compliance with relevant regulatory authorities (MGA, Mincetur, SPA, AGCO etc.) 
  • Ensure compliance with relevant frameworks (e.g., GDPR, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS).
  • Conduct regular audits and technical assessments to evaluate risk and compliance.
  • Develop and maintain compliance documentation, including security policies, data handling procedures, and audit reports.
  • Assist Chief Compliance officer to launch the new project in existing or new markets.
  • Stay up to date with changes in laws and regulations affecting data privacy,  various regulatory frameworks, cybersecurity, and industry standards.
  • Provide guidance and training to staff on compliance-related matters.
  • Manage third-party vendor compliance assessments and onboarding processes.
  • Coordinate internal and external audits; respond to audit findings and implement corrective actions.
  • Assist in incident response investigations and ensure post-incident compliance actions are executed.


Requirements:


  • 2-4 years of experience in compliance or risk/aml management (IT security would be a plus).
  • Previous experience in compliance, data protection laws and cyber security.
  • Exceptional documentation and analytical skills.


Working with us implies:

﻿

  • Memorable company parties and social activities like team buildings and monthly birthday celebrations.
  • Working in a company with a global culture, experience, and reach.
  • Working on-site in our modern, bright, and comfortable office space located in downtown Foz do Iguaçu, with a great working atmosphere, a collaborative team of amazing people, and open-minded managers.
  • Opportunities to build valuable skills, work with unique and interesting projects for the sports industry, express and implement your ideas and grow your career.


The monthly salary range will depend on the selected candidate's experience and skills. We will contact only shortlisted candidates.

title: Project Manager
description:
Join Aditi Consulting as a Project Manager!


Summary:

We are seeking a Project Manager to support a global M&A divestiture initiative involving the disposition of 150+ applications across multiple regions, including significant collaboration with teams in Japan . This role requires ERP experience (SAP, Epicor, ETQ, Reliance, or similar), strong technical communication skills, and the ability to manage tight timelines driven by Transition Service Agreements (TSAs) .

Responsibilities:

  • Lead global application disposition efforts across multiple waves of work.
  • Manage timelines tied to TSA deadlines to avoid costly extensions.
  • Coordinate closely with technical teams on integrations, workflows, and decommissioning plans.
  • Work with sourcing, suppliers, purchasing, and invoicing teams to ensure vendor alignment.
  • Facilitate meetings with global stakeholders, including late-night sessions with Japan-based teams (flex schedule provided).
  • Drive project planning, risk management, documentation, and status reporting.
  • Ensure smooth communication and alignment across business, IT, and regional teams.

Required Qualifications:

  • Proven Project Management experience in M&A divestiture environments.
  • Familiarity with Transition Service Agreements (TSAs) .
  • Experience with at least one ERP or enterprise platform (SAP, Epicor, ETQ, Reliance, etc.).
  • Strong understanding of sourcing, suppliers, purchasing, and invoicing processes.
  • Excellent English communication skills , including the ability to follow technical integration discussions.
  • Experience working with global or cross-cultural teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Project Management certification (PMP, Prince2, Agile/Scrum).
  • Experience collaborating with Japan or APAC teams.
  • Background in application disposition, decommissioning, or IT transformation.
  • Knowledge of integration workflows and system dependencies.

Soft Skills:

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication abilities.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and drive clarity in complex technical environments.
  • Proactive risk identification and problem-solving.
  • High level of organization and multitasking in fast-paced settings.
  • Flexibility and adaptability when working across global time zones.

title: Visual Designer – Pleno
description:
Código da vaga: 58109


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei #fera em design visual, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos por #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Forte domínio de design de informação e hierarquia visual .
  • Storytelling aplicado : começo–meio–fim, argumento, ritmo, síntese e foco no essencial.
  • Capacidade de entender o contexto antes de desenhar : fazer perguntas, captar objetivos e propor caminhos.
  • Excelência em padronização e construção de sistemas : templates e componentes reutilizáveis.
  • Experiência com Microsoft Power Point, Power Designer .
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado para lidar com materiais.


- O que vai te destacar?

  • Materiais para consultorias (estratégia/produto/branding/design).
  • Storytelling para executivos e apresentações de alto impacto.
  • Design systems aplicados a apresentações e documentos.
  • Criação de bibliotecas de templates do zero .



- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Instructional Designer
description:
Instructional Designer/Training Content Creator


*English Resume Only

Role Type: Full-Time Contract

Hours: Must be willing to work US EST Hours

Location: Brazil

Reporting To: VP of Operations


About The Methodical Group


The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as ExactTalent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.


About the Opportunity


Our client, a growing SaaS organization within the healthcare sector, is seeking an experienced Instructional Designer / Content Training Creator to support product adoption and end-user engagement.

This individual will be responsible for developing high-quality training materials aligned to new feature releases and product enhancements. Content will include step-by-step documentation, video tutorials, and embedded in-app learning resources.

The ideal candidate is structured, detail-oriented, and highly collaborative — capable of working cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and Support teams to ensure training materials are accurate, timely, and aligned with customer needs.

This role directly supports customer adoption, user enablement, and long-term retention.


Ideal Candidate Profile


  • 3–6+ years of experience in instructional design, technical writing, or SaaS training content creation
  • Experience creating both written documentation and video tutorials
  • Strong ability to translate technical product features into user-friendly materials
  • Experience supporting SaaS product releases
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration experience
  • Familiarity with knowledge base or help desk platforms
  • Experience embedding or structuring in-app training resources preferred


Preferred Experience


  • Experience within healthcare or other regulated SaaS environments
  • Experience supporting product adoption initiatives
  • Familiarity with user enablement or digital adoption strategies
  • Experience working in fast-paced, release-driven environments


Key Responsibilities


Training Content Development

  • Develop clear, structured training materials for new feature releases and product updates
  • Create step-by-step documentation, user guides, and process walkthroughs
  • Produce video tutorials and screen-recorded demonstrations
  • Maintain consistent instructional design standards across all materials

Product Release Collaboration

  • Partner with Product and internal stakeholders during the feature release lifecycle
  • Translate technical functionality into user-friendly instructional content
  • Document workflows, use cases, and feature capabilities
  • Track release timelines to ensure training materials are delivered in sync with launch

Content Maintenance & Optimization

  • Audit and update existing training materials as product functionality evolves
  • Ensure documentation accuracy and consistency
  • Identify content gaps impacting user adoption
  • Improve clarity and accessibility of user-facing materials

Platform & Knowledge Base Integration

  • Prepare content for embedding within the application and support platform
  • Organize materials for easy user navigation and searchability
  • Support continuous improvement of knowledge base structure

Adoption & Enablement Support

  • Create content that drives end-user adoption of key modules and features
  • Develop materials aligned to different user personas
  • Monitor feedback from Customer Success and Support teams to refine training assets

title: Senior Front-End Software Engineer (React.js / React Native / TypeScript)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Front-End Software Engineer with 5+ years of professional front-end development experience using React.js, React Native, and TypeScript for our U.K. / U.S. client. You will design, build, and maintain high‑impact user interfaces — from customer dashboards and data visualizations to our React Native mobile app.

Our client is a nature data and intelligence company on a mission to drive large-scale nature recovery. They combine data, science, and technology to help enterprises value and restore nature, creating measurable environmental and economic impact.


Responsibilities

  • Own front-end delivery for key product surfaces across web and mobile taking features from technical feasibility through technical design, implementation, release, and iteration
  • Build and evolve UI foundations including component patterns, design-system primitives, reusable layouts, and interaction standards that keep UX consistent as the product scales
  • Translate product and design intent into clear, intuitive user flows sweating the details on information hierarchy, micro-interactions, accessibility, and polish
  • Ship performant, data-heavy interfaces in Next.js / React.js, with strong attention to perceived performance (e.g., loading states, empty states, progressive disclosure, and responsiveness)
  • Contribute meaningfully to the React Native app, delivering cross-platform UI and shared patterns where it makes sense, while handling platform-specific edge cases when needed
  • Use automated testing to ensure the UI quality, stability, and performance
  • Partner tightly with Product, Design, and Tech Lead to scope work into thin, shippable increments, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and keep delivery moving without sacrificing quality


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of professional experience building production, front-end applications with React.js and TypeScript
  • Experience building and supporting cross-platform, React Native features in a production application
  • Strong eye for UI and UX quality, paying close attention to interaction behavior, information hierarchy, accessibility, and polish
  • Proven experience implementing and operating within a component library / design system (e.g., tokens, reusable components, consistency, and documentation) in close collaboration with Design
  • Strong fundamentals in state management, responsive design, and performance optimization including perceived performance (e.g., loading states, skeletons, optimistic UI, and smooth interactions)
  • Comfortable taking ambiguous product requirements and turning them into clear UI flows, iterating quickly with stakeholders, and owning outcomes
  • Shareable portfolio or examples of UI work (e.g. links, screenshots) as well as the ability to explain what you personally owned and enhanced
  • Proactive mindset and the ability to self-manage in a distributed environment
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment


Desired Experience

  • Experience with mobile release workflows (App Store / Play Store), build tooling, and troubleshooting React Native native-module / platform-specific issues
  • Experience with data visualization libraries (e.g., D3.js, Recharts) and/or map-based UI (e.g., Mapbox)
